jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Global Network Management department is responsible for the management and strategy of Bank Julius Baer’s custodian and cash correspondent relationships. As a Global Network Manager, you will be responsible for managing this network of Agent Banks. We are a pivotal team that has touchpoints across the entire global organisation and a significant impact on the success of the firm. In this highly varied role, you will be responsible for the management of all aspects of these relationships and play a central role in ensuring best in class provision of post trade services to the bank, as well as further developing the network
to meet our evolving needs. In this exciting role - no two days will be the same. The opening would suit a candidate with ambition to develop a broad, cross-disciplinary expertise and have exposure to a wide range of processes and initiatives. We look forward to hearing from you!

YOUR CHALLENGE
Global responsibility for assigned custodian and cash correspondent relationships, which
includes:
• Active service management of Agent Bank relationships, conducting regular service meetings, service reviews, due diligences, the active monitoring, and management of service provision to Bank Julius Baer
• Negotiation and management of fees, ensuring understanding of costs, evolution, as well as idea generation and implementation to achieve cost optimisations
• Oversight of contracts, negotiation, and implementation of documentation necessary for these relationships
• Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and deliver on continued Front to Back process optimisation across the network
• Understanding of market and agent developments, trends, and opportunities to Bank Julius Baer and dissemination to stakeholders
• Maintain deep understanding of the custody rules and a strong ability to apply knowledges to support with internal advisory / consultancy to support business and client needs
Bank Julius Baer service delivery which includes:
• Develop deep custody and payments expertise to be able to provide guidance to client facing units on local account opening requirements, market custody rules and service issues
• Establish and maintain strong relationships with all key internal stakeholders associated with custody and cash correspondent service (ie. Operations, Trading, Global Custody, Private Banking Front Office, Compliance, etc)
• Respond promptly and effectively to any market specific queries and escalations from Business, Operations, or other colleagues
• Work in the team to support colleagues with markets and tasks as and when required
• Contribute to special projects and initiatives within Bank Julius Baer as required
• Undertake necessary steps with internal and external colleagues to remediate any identified issues to ensure market compliance
• Contribute to help shape a culture of openness, enthusiasm and curiosity within the team and the firm

YOUR PROFILE
• Relevant experience in a Network Management, Financial Institutions, Relationship Management or Client facing role in a banking environment preferred
• Demonstrated track record managing vendors and/or internal stakeholders, ideally related to custodian and cash correspondent preferred
• At least general knowledge of custody operations, market rules and cash operations, correspondent services
• Excellent interpersonal skills and able to build strong relationships with internal and external partners
• Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities under pressure. Demonstratable can-do mindset and a structured working style
• Ability to identify root causes of issues and required remediation under pressure
• Proactive, self-motivated mindset and willingness to take on responsibility.
• Excellent analytical, decision making and problem-solving skills to effectively resolve and/or guide the resolution of service issues
• Willingness to understand the mechanics of processes and to continue to develop expertise
• Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to manage external and internal relationships and represent Bank Julius Baer influencing to lead negotiations
• Strong team player, able to multi-task in a dynamic business environment
• Excellent data analysis and presentation skills are essential, an aptitude for technology will be an added advantage
• Good MS Word, Excel and PowerPoint skills essential, an aptitude for technology will be an added advantage
• Proficiency in German and English (written and spoken) essential, additional languages are a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi Siamo A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che si portano, consentendo di essere influenti, di essere imprenditoriale, di essere autorizzati, e di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Lasciate che il futuro della gestione della ricchezza insieme. Descrizione Il dipartimento di Gestione della Rete Globale è responsabile della gestione e della strategia di Bank Julius Baer.s custode e rapporti di corrispondenza in denaro. Come Global Network Manager, sarà responsabile della gestione di questa rete di Agent Banks. Siamo un team fondamentale che ha punti di contatto in tutta l'organizzazione globale e un impatto significativo sul successo dell'azienda. In questo ruolo molto vario, sarete responsabili della gestione di tutti gli aspetti di queste relazioni e svolgerete un ruolo centrale nel garantire il meglio nella fornitura di servizi post-commercio di classe alla banca, nonché nello sviluppo ulteriore della rete per soddisfare le nostre esigenze in evoluzione. In questo ruolo entusiasmante - non ci saranno due giorni uguali. L'apertura si addicerebbe ad un candidato con l'ambizione di sviluppare un'ampia competenza interdisciplinare e avere esposizione ad una vasta gamma di processi e iniziative. Responsabilità La SFIDA Responsabilità globale per i rapporti di deposito e di corrispondente in contanti assegnati, che comprende: - Gestione attiva dei rapporti con l'agente Banca, svolgimento di riunioni regolari di servizio, revisioni dei servizi, due diligence, monitoraggio attivo e gestione della fornitura di servizi a Bank Julius Baer - Negoziazione e gestione delle commissioni, garanzia di comprensione dei costi, evoluzione, nonché generazione di idee e attuazione per ottenere ottimizzazioni dei costi - Supervisione dei contratti, negoziazione e attuazione della documentazione necessaria per questi relazioni - Collaborare con le parti interessate per identificare e fornire l'ottimizzazione continua del processo Front to Back in tutta la rete - Comprensione degli sviluppi del mercato e degli agenti, tendenze e opportunità per Bank Julius Baer e diffusione alle parti interessate - Mantenere una profonda comprensione delle regole di custodia e una forte capacità di applicare le conoscenze per supportare con consulenza interna / consulenza per sostenere le esigenze aziendali e dei clienti Bank Julius Baer consegna del servizio che include: - Sviluppare competenze di custodia e pagamenti per essere in grado di fornire orientamenti ai clienti affrontando le unità su requisiti di apertura dei conti locali, regole di custodia del mercato e questioni di servizio - Stabilire e mantenere forti relazioni con tutti i principali soggetti interni coinvolti nel servizio di custodia e corrispondente in contanti (es. Operazioni, Trading, Custodia Globale, Private Banking Front Office, Compliance, ecc. - Rispondere prontamente ed efficacemente a qualsiasi domanda e crescente richiesta di mercato da parte di Business, Operazioni o altri colleghi - Lavorare nel team per supportare i colleghi con mercati e compiti come e quando richiesto - Contribuire a progetti speciali e iniziative in seno a Bank Julius Baer se necessario - Intraprendere i passi necessari con colleghi interni ed esterni per remediare eventuali problemi identificati per garantire la conformità del mercato - Contribuire a contribuire a formare una cultura di apertura, entusiasmo e curiosità all'interno della squadra e lo studio
• Requisiti Il tuo PROFILE - Esperienza rilevante in una gestione di rete, istituzioni finanziarie, gestione delle relazioni o ruolo di fronte al cliente in un ambiente bancario preferito - Dimostrata gestione dei record di track e/o stakeholder interni, idealmente legato al custode e corrispondente al contante preferito - Almeno conoscenza generale delle operazioni di custodia, regole di mercato e operazioni di cassa, servizi corrispondenti - Ottime competenze interpersonali e in grado di costruire forti relazioni con partner interni ed esterni - Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di gestire concorrenti priorità sotto pressione. Dimostrabile capacità di fare la mente e uno stile di lavoro strutturato - Capacità di identificare le cause profonde dei problemi e necessaria bonifica sotto pressione - Proattivo, auto-motivato mentalità e la volontà di assumersi la responsabilità. - Eccellente capacità analitica, decisionale e di risoluzione dei problemi per risolvere efficacemente e/o guidare la risoluzione dei problemi di servizio - Volontà di comprendere la meccanica dei processi e di continuare a sviluppare competenze - Comunicazione eccezionale e capacità interpersonali per gestire relazioni esterne e interne e rappresentare la Banca Julius Baer che influenza per condurre trattative - Forte giocatore di squadra, in grado di multi-task in un ambiente dinamico di business - Ottima analisi dei dati e capacità di presentazione sono essenziali, un'attitudine per la tecnologia sarà un vantaggio aggiunto - Buona MS Word, Excel e competenze PowerPoint essenziali, un'attitudine per la tecnologia sarà un vantaggio aggiunto - Proficienza in tedesco e inglese (scritto e parlato) essenziale, ulteriori lingue sono un plus Contatto Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completo attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro possono essere trovati sul nostro sito Career. Non è questo che stai cercando? Configurare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft des Vermögensmanagements gestalten. Beschreibung Die Abteilung Global Network Management ist für die Verwaltung und Strategie der Bank Julius Baer, deren Korrespondenten- und Kassen-Beziehungen, verantwortlich. Als Global Network Manager sind Sie für die Verwaltung dieses Netzwerks von Agent Banks verantwortlich. Wir sind ein zentrales Team, das Berührungspunkte über die gesamte globale Organisation und einen erheblichen Einfluss auf den Erfolg des Unternehmens hat. In dieser sehr abwechslungsreichen Rolle sind Sie für die Verwaltung aller Aspekte dieser Beziehungen verantwortlich und spielen eine zentrale Rolle bei der Gewährleistung der besten Bereitstellung von Post-Trade-Services für die Bank und der Weiterentwicklung des Netzwerks, um unsere sich entwickelnden Bedürfnisse zu erfüllen. In dieser spannenden Rolle - keine zwei Tage wird die gleiche sein. Die Öffnung würde einem Kandidaten mit dem Ehrgeiz, eine breite, disziplinübergreifende Expertise zu entwickeln und haben Engagement für eine Vielzahl von Prozessen und Initiativen. Wir freuen uns auf Sie! À propos de nous Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'être impacté, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Description Le département Global Network Management est responsable de la gestion et de la stratégie de la banque Julius Baer, dépositaire et correspondant en espèces. En tant que responsable du réseau mondial, vous serez responsable de la gestion de ce réseau d'Agent Banks. Nous sommes une équipe pivotante qui a des points de contact dans toute l'organisation mondiale et un impact significatif sur le succès de l'entreprise. Dans ce rôle très varié, vous serez responsable de la gestion de tous les aspects de ces relations et jouerez un rôle central pour assurer la meilleure prestation de services post-négociations de classe à la banque, ainsi que pour développer le réseau afin de répondre à nos besoins en évolution. Dans ce rôle passionnant - pas de deux jours seront les mêmes. L'ouverture conviendrait à un candidat avec l'ambition de développer une vaste expertise interdisciplinaire et d'avoir une exposition à un large éventail de processus et d'initiatives. Responsabilités VOTRE DÉFIS Responsabilité mondiale pour les relations de dépositaire et de correspondant en espèces assignées, qui comprend : - la gestion active des services des relations avec les agents de la Banque, la tenue de réunions régulières sur les services, l'examen des services, les diligences requises, le suivi actif et la gestion de la prestation de services à la Banque Julius Baer - la négociation et la gestion des frais, la compréhension des coûts, l'évolution, ainsi que la production et la mise en oeuvre d'idées pour atteindre les coûts. - Établir des liens avec les intervenants afin de cerner et de fournir des services continus de base - Comprendre les évolutions du marché et des agents, les tendances et les possibilités pour la Banque Julius Baer et les diffuser aux intervenants - Maintenir une compréhension approfondie des règles de garde et une forte capacité d'appliquer les connaissances pour appuyer les besoins internes en matière de conseils et de conseils pour les entreprises et les clients. exigences d'ouverture de compte local, règles de garde du marché et questions de service - Établir et maintenir des relations solides avec toutes les parties prenantes internes clés associées au service de garde et de correspondant en espèces (p. ex. Opérations, Trading, Global Custody, Private Banking Front Office, Compliance, etc.) - Respond répond rapidement et efficacement à toutes les demandes et escalades spécifiques du marché des affaires, des opérations ou d'autres collègues - Travaille dans l'équipe pour soutenir ses collègues avec les marchés et les tâches au besoin - contribue à des projets et initiatives spéciaux au sein de la Banque Julius Baer au besoin - prend les mesures nécessaires avec ses collègues internes et externes pour remédier à toute question identifiée pour assurer la conformité au marché - contribue à façonner une culture d'ouverture, d'enthousiasme et de curiosité au sein de la Banque équipe et le cabinet
• Exigences VOTRE PROFIL - Expérience pertinente dans un environnement bancaire privilégié dans la gestion de réseau, les institutions financières, la gestion des relations ou le client - Expérience démontrée de la gestion des fournisseurs et/ou des intervenants internes, idéalement liée au gardien et correspondant en espèces préféré - Connaissances générales des opérations de garde, des règles de marché et des opérations en espèces, des services correspondants - Excellentes compétences interpersonnelles et capables d'établir des relations solides avec les partenaires internes et externes - Fortes compétences organisationnelles avec la capacité de gérer la concurrence les priorités sous pression. jobs.title: Compliance Working Student – Monitoring & Control Execution 60 - 80% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Join the Central Compliance team as a Working Student and actively support the execution of second-line compliance monitoring activities. You will collaborate with the Monitoring & Control Execution team to help ensure adherence to regulatory and internal requirements across key risk areas such as Client Suitability and Pricing Governance.

This is a hands-on role offering structured learning and practical experience, and your contributions will directly support the team’s mission to uphold high compliance standards and strengthen internal controls.
It’s an excellent opportunity for a motivated university student aiming to build expertise in financial regulation, risk assurance, and control operations, preparing you for a future career in compliance, risk management, or financial services.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the planning and execution of recurring compliance control activities, including sampling, data collection, and initial evidence review

• Validate documentation provided by Client-Facing Units against established control criteria

• Maintain accurate records in control tracking tools and ensure proper filing of test evidence

• Prepare draft analyses, summaries, and presentation materials for internal reporting and management updates

• Contribute to deficiency management processes by assisting in follow-ups and resolution tracking

• Participate in process improvement initiatives, including automation ideas, digital tool enhancements, or policy reviews

YOUR PROFILE

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s programme in Business Administration, Finance, Law, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field

• Genuine interest in financial compliance, regulatory frameworks, and private banking operations

• Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel (pivot tables, lookups) and PowerPoint (executive presentations)

• Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage timelines and multiple small assignments simultaneously

• Fluent in English (written and spoken), other languages are an advantage

• Highly motivated and self-driven student with proactive mindset and attitude

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Lombard Credit Officer 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start until 23.12.2026)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for all Lombard risk aspects of a portfolio of domestic and international private banking clients. Assess, analyse, structure, approve, implement and monitor Lombard credit requests / transactions. Provide credit advisory service to internal clients and work hand-in-hand with RMs /first line of defense to customise appropriate solutions to the end clients.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Analysis and assessment of collateral and exposure (e.g. derivatives) including detection of concentration risks

• Assessment of borrower, collateral provider with regards to structural, legal, compliance and reputational risks

• Determination of risk rating for a credit facility

• Preparation and approval of credit limits within the delegated credit approval authority (depending on risk rating and amount)

• Application of special lending values and margin terms on client specific level

• Ongoing monitoring of credit exposure; resolving of collateral shortfalls and limit excesses, including issuance of margin calls

• Regular review of approved limits

• Administration duties, e.g. fixed term loans approval, payment and securities releases and proper credit documentation

• Deputize other Credit Officers in their absence

• Support relationship managers and other stakeholders in all credit related matters, establish regular and proactive contact as well as providing ongoing credit training

• Contribution in credit related projects and process improvements

• Work with legal to draft non-standard documents related to credit transactions

• Preparation and performing of training session for Credit Officer and Relationship Manager

YOUR PROFILE

• University Bachelor degree or completed studies at a university of applied sciences (economics, banking, finance, law), or equivalent education or professional experience

• Several years of professional experience in the credit sector (in particular Lombard credit) is an advantage

• Solid technical knowledge regarding the handling of life insurance policies (wrappers, ULIPs) is a plus

• Interest in the functioning of financial markets and financial institutions

• Good IT skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and excellent analytical skills

• Independent, reliable, and team-oriented personality

• Solution oriented with problem solving and negotiating skills

• Strong analytical skills, developed awareness in legal, tax and reputational issues

• Personality with good organizational and operational skills and ability to work under high pressure

• Sense of integrity and discretion

• Excellent communication and solid presentation skills

• Perseverance and persistence

• Excellent German and English language skills (written and spoken), any additional languages are an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As Team Lead Web Entry Solutions, you assume strategic and operational responsibility for the operation and continuous advancement of our central web entry security infrastructures. You lead a globally distributed, highly specialised team at our locations in Switzerland and Singapore, and play a key role in making the security architecture of a leading global financial institution fit for the future.
Working in close collaboration with IT Service Owners, architects and engineering teams, you drive the delivery of demanding security projects and provide expert guidance to business units on complex security topics. You combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership skills and a strategic view of the overall IT security posture.

YOUR CHALLENGE

Operations & Web Application Security Architecture

• Own the stable operation and strategic development of core IT security infrastructures in the Web Entry domain

• Design, implement and continuously optimise Web Application Firewall and API security architectures based on the Nevis Identity Suite – including rule sets, filter policies and WAF configurations

• Operate, configure and advance security functions such as ModSecurity and Core Rule Sets (CRS)

• Design, implement and operate Global Single Sign-On (GSSO) solutions based on SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC)

• Ensure comprehensive protection against all OWASP Top 10 vulnerability categories (Injection, Broken Access Control, XSS, SSRF, etc.) at both infrastructure and application level

• Operate and evolve load-balancing solutions and multi-layered DDoS protection mechanisms (rate limiting, IP reputation management, bot management)

• Monitor and analyse HTTP/S traffic for anomalies, attack patterns and policy violations using centralised logging and SIEM platforms

Security Governance, Assessments & Projects

• Own security assessments, vulnerability management and baseline compliance across the Web Entry platforms

• Evaluate and prioritise findings from penetration tests, DAST scans and bug bounty programmes; coordinate remediation with development and operations teams

• Drive and deliver complex security projects with a strategic view of the overall IT security posture

• Analyse and manage security incidents (web attacks, WAF bypasses, credential stuffing, bot traffic) and coordinate incident response

• Create and maintain security concepts, WAF policies, technical documentation and operating procedures

• Continuously optimise WAF rule sets, proxy configurations and security baselines; identify and implement improvement opportunities

Leadership & Advisory

• Provide disciplinary and functional leadership to a globally distributed team in Switzerland and Singapore

• Advise and support business units on security topics; actively accompany new security initiatives from concept through to production deployment

• Collaborate closely with IT Service Owners, architects, engineering teams and external partners in a regulated enterprise environment

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree (BSc / MSc / ETH) or higher technical qualification (HF/FH) in Computer Science, Information Security or a comparable technical discipline

• In-depth, demonstrated knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 – mandatory: hands-on experience in identifying, assessing and mitigating all current vulnerability categories

• Strong hands-on expertise in configuring, operating and tuning ModSecurity including the OWASP CRS – experience with false-positive management and custom rule development is mandatory

• Solid understanding of web application architectures: HTTP/S protocol, REST APIs, reverse-proxy concepts, TLS/mTLS, Content Security Policy (CSP), CORS, HTTP security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.)

• Demonstrated practical experience with the Nevis Identity Suite or comparable enterprise WAF / reverse-proxy solutions (e.g. F5 ASM, Barracuda WAF, AWS WAF, Azure Application Gateway WAF)

• Knowledge of security-focused API protection: API gateways, OAuth 2.0 token validation, rate limiting, input validation

• Experience handling penetration-testing findings and security-focused code reviews in a web application context

• Sound, proven expertise in network and application security – this role is not suitable for career starters

• Solid knowledge of modern authentication and authorisation protocols (SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, OAuth 2.0, PKCE)

• Proficient in Azure security concepts: Azure Policy, Identity Governance in Microsoft Entra ID, AKS Security Posture Management, Microsoft Defender for Cloud

• Demonstrated experience in hybrid environments (cloud and on-premises) and in the secure operation of containerised workloads (Kubernetes, Docker)

• Proven track record in disciplinary and functional management of internationally distributed teams, ideally in a complex, global environment

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills at all organisational levels

• Fluent English – written and spoken (working language)

Nice to have:

• Experience in the financial sector, in regulated environments or audit-intensive contexts (e.g. FINMA, MAS, DORA)

• Recognised security certifications: CISM, CISSP, CCSP, AZ-500, SC-100 or GWAPT (GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester)

• Knowledge of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC) and DevSecOps practices, e.g. SAST/DAST integration in CI/CD pipelines

• Familiarity with the OWASP Application Security Verification Standard (ASVS) as an assessment framework for web applications

• Experience with threat modelling (e.g. STRIDE) and structured risk analysis of web architectures

• Understanding of cloud-native DevOps practices or cloud platform operating models (e.g. AKS, Azure Landing Zones, Infrastructure as Code)

• German language skills

Koordination der Sanierung mit Entwicklungs- und Operationsteams - Antrieb und Bereitstellung komplexer Sicherheitsprojekte mit einem strategischen Blick auf die gesamte IT-Sicherheitshaltung - Analyse und Verwaltung von Sicherheitsvorfällen (Webangriffe, WAF-Umgehungen, credential stopfing, Bot-Verkehr) und Koordination von Störfallreaktionen - Erstellung und Pflege von Sicherheitskonzepten, WAF-Richtlinien, technische Dokumentation und Betriebsverfahren - Kontinuierliche Optimierung von WAF-Regelsätzen, Proxykonfigurationen und Sicherheits-Basislinien; Ermittlung und Implementierung von Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten Leadership & Advisory - Führen Sie ein weltweit verteiltes Team in der Schweiz und Singapur disziplinarisch und funktional – beraten und unterstützen Sie Geschäftseinheiten zu Sicherheitsthemen; begleiten Sie aktiv neue Sicherheitsinitiativen von der Konzeption bis zur Produktion - arbeiten Sie eng mit IT Service Owners, Architekten, Engineering Teams und externen Partnern in einer regulierten Unternehmensumgebung zusammen

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) to join our global security engineering team in Zurich. As the ideal candidate, you possess deep expertise in secure remote access technologies, strong authentication and identity integration skills, and hands-on experience operating enterprise-grade remote connectivity platforms within a regulated financial services environment. You are comfortable working across infrastructure, security, endpoint, and identity domains, ensuring that employees, contractors, and approved third parties can securely access corporate resources.

Your primary responsibilities will involve architecting, operating, and continuously improving the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, integrating and maintaining multi-factor authentication solutions, enforcing secure access and conditional access policies, and ensuring the resilience, security, and compliance of the Bank’s remote access services.

In addition, you will contribute to the design, implementation, and operationalisation of the Bank’s future Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform and support the evolution of the remote access landscape towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architecture. Working closely with IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations, and Global IT teams, you will help deliver secure, reliable, and scalable remote connectivity aligned with regulatory requirements and the Bank’s strategic security roadmap.

Beyond the remote access domain, you will also have the opportunity to contribute to and gain hands-on experience with other security services managed by the team, including Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), and Secure Mail Gateway solutions. This provides an excellent opportunity for candidates looking to broaden their expertise across multiple security domains and further develop their security engineering career within a collaborative and highly skilled team.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• As part of a dedicated security engineering team, administer, configure, and continuously improve the Bank’s Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway infrastructure, ensuring high availability, performance, scalability, and operational resilience across primary and disaster recovery environments

• Manage and maintain SSL-VPN and clientless access services, including virtual server configurations, authentication policies, rewrite rules, responder policies, and traffic steering mechanisms

• Design, implement, and maintain secure authentication and conditional access policies based on user identity, device type, network location, and contextual risk factors

• Participate in the design, implementation, and rollout of the Bank’s Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) platform, supporting the transition towards a modern Zero Trust Network Access architecture and contributing to technical design, testing, integration, and operational readiness activities

• Develop and maintain expertise across both Citrix NetScaler Gateway and Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) technologies, supporting the Bank’s strategic remote access roadmap and ensuring secure, seamless connectivity across multiple access platforms

• Plan, coordinate, and execute infrastructure upgrades, security patches, policy changes, and platform enhancements in accordance with established change management processes within a regulated financial environment

• Provide 2nd and 3rd level engineering support for the Bank’s remote access platforms, acting as an escalation point for complex incidents and participating in a shared 24/7 on-call rotation for critical services

YOUR PROFILE

• Highly proactive, solution-oriented, and capable of independently assessing, prioritising, and resolving complex technical challenges in a structured and efficient manner

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments

• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• University degree or higher technical education (university of applied sciences, federal diploma) in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related discipline — or equivalent practical experience

• Minimum 3–5 years of hands-on experience in IT Security or Infrastructure Engineering, with a strong focus on secure remote access, identity management, authentication technologies, and endpoint security

• In-depth expertise in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway, including hands-on experience with AAA policies, virtual server configuration, SSL-VPN services, high-availability deployments, authentication flows, and troubleshooting via both GUI and CLI

• Knowledge of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) concepts and architectures; experience with Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) or comparable ZTNA technologies is considered an advantage

• Practical scripting and automation skills using one or more of PowerShell, Python, or Bash, including automation of certificate validation, health checks, log analysis, and operational tasks through REST APIs, Citrix Nitro API, or comparable interfaces

• Practical experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory, and hybrid identity environments

• Proven experience integrating remote access platforms with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) solutions and modern identity providers

• Strong understanding of endpoint compliance validation, device trust concepts, BYOD access models, and modern remote access security architectures

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements

• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and translate technical concepts into practical solutions

• Fluent written and spoken English (B2/C1)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

Titolo di lavoro Ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) Descrizione A Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le singole qualità che portate, consentendovi di essere efficaci, di essere imprenditoriali, di essere capaci di creare valore oltre la ricchezza. Lasciamoci plasmare insieme il futuro della gestione della ricchezza.
• Stiamo cercando un esperto ingegnere di accesso remoto (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) per entrare a far parte del nostro team di ingegneria globale della sicurezza a Zurigo. Come candidato ideale, possedete una profonda esperienza in tecnologie di accesso remoto sicuro, forti abilità di autenticazione e integrazione dell'identità e un'esperienza pratica nell'esercizio di piattaforme di connettività remota di livello enterprise all'interno di un ambiente di servizi finanziari regolamentati. Siete a vostro agio a lavorare attraverso infrastrutture, sicurezza, endpoint e domini di identità, assicurando che dipendenti, appaltatori e terze parti approvate possano accedere in modo sicuro alle risorse aziendali. Le vostre responsabilità principali saranno l'architettura, il funzionamento e il miglioramento continuo dell'infrastruttura Bank.s Citrix NetScaler Gateway, l'integrazione e il mantenimento di soluzioni di autenticazione multi-fattori, l'applicazione di un accesso sicuro e di politiche di accesso condizionato, e garantire la resilienza, la sicurezza e la conformità dei servizi di accesso remoto della Banca.s. Inoltre, contribuirete alla progettazione, implementazione e implementazione della futura piattaforma Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) e supportate l'evoluzione del paesaggio di accesso remoto verso una moderna architettura Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). Lavorando a stretto contatto con IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations e Global IT team, contribuirete a fornire connettività remota sicura, affidabile e scalabile in linea con i requisiti normativi e la tabella di marcia strategica della Banca per la sicurezza. Oltre al dominio di accesso remoto, avrete anche la possibilità di contribuire e acquisire esperienza pratica con altri servizi di sicurezza gestiti dal team, tra cui Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Privileged Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), e Secure Mail Gateway soluzioni. Ciò offre un'ottima opportunità per i candidati che cercano di ampliare la loro esperienza in più settori di sicurezza e sviluppare ulteriormente la loro carriera di ingegneria della sicurezza all'interno di un team collaborativo e altamente qualificato. Responsabilità - Gestione, configurazione e miglioramento continuo dell'infrastruttura di gateway Citrix NetScaler ADC e NetScaler, garantendo elevata disponibilità, performance, mobilità e resilienza operativa in ambienti di recupero primari e disaster recovery - Gestire e mantenere servizi di accesso senza client SSL-VPN, incluse configurazioni server virtuali, politiche di autenticazione, riscrittura delle regole, politiche dei responder e meccanismi di gestione del traffico - Progettare, implementare e mantenere l'autenticazione sicura e le politiche di accesso condizionato basate sull'identità dell'utente, sul tipo di dispositivo, sulla rete location, e fattori di rischio contestuali - Partecipa alla progettazione, attuazione e implementazione della piattaforma di accesso privato Zscaler (ZPA), sostenendo la transizione verso una moderna architettura di accesso alla rete Zero Trust e contribuendo alla progettazione tecnica, testing, integrazione e preparazione operativa - sviluppare e mantenere competenze sia in Citrix NetScaler Gateway che in Zscaler Private Access (ZPA), supportando la tabella di marcia strategica per l'accesso remoto della Banca e garantendo una connettività sicura e senza soluzione di continuità su più piattaforme di accesso - Pianificare, coordinare e eseguire aggiornamenti dell'infrastruttura, patch di sicurezza, modifiche politiche e miglioramenti delle piattaforme in conformità con processi di gestione dei cambiamenti stabiliti in un ambiente finanziario regolamentato - Fornire supporto ingegneristico di secondo e terzo livello per le piattaforme di accesso remoto della Banca, fungendo da punto di escalation per incidenti complessi e partecipando a una rotazione 24/7 condivisa di chiamata per i servizi critici
• Requisiti - Altamente proattivi, orientati alla soluzione e in grado di valutare, dare priorità e risolvere in modo strutturato ed efficiente complesse sfide tecniche - Forte capacità analitiche e concettuali di pensiero con un alto livello di attenzione ai dettagli, in particolare quando si lavora in ambienti critici e altamente regolamentati - Volontà e curiosità di imparare nuove tecnologie ed espandere le competenze in diversi settori di sicurezza, contribuendo alla continua evoluzione dei servizi di sicurezza della Banca - Laurea universitaria o istruzione tecnica superiore (università di scienze applicate, diploma federale) in Informatica, sicurezza dell'informazione, o una disciplina correlata. o un'esperienza pratica equivalente - Minimo 3,5 anni di esperienza pratica in IT Security o Ingegneria delle infrastrutture, con una forte attenzione per l'accesso remoto sicuro, gestione dell'identità, tecnologie di autenticazione, e la sicurezza endpoint - Approfondimento delle competenze in Citrix NetScaler ADC e NetScaler Gateway, tra cui esperienza pratica con politiche AAA, configurazione server virtuale, servizi SSL-VPN, implementazioni ad alta disponibilità, flussi di autenticazione e risoluzione dei problemi tramite GUI e CLI - Conoscenza dei concetti e delle architetture di Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA); esperienza con le tecnologie Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) o comparabili ZTNA è considerata un vantaggio - competenze pratiche di scripting e automazione utilizzando uno o più di PowerShell, Python o Bash, compresa l'automazione della validazione dei certificati, controlli sanitari, analisi dei log e attività operative attraverso API REST, Citrix Nitro API, o interfacce comparabili - esperienza pratica con Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Active Directory e ambienti di identità ibrida - esperienza Proven integrando piattaforme di accesso remoto con soluzioni Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) e moderni fornitori di identità - Una forte comprensione della validazione della conformità agli endpoint, concetti di device trust, modelli di accesso BYOD e moderne architetture di sicurezza per accesso remoto - Esperienza che lavora all'interno di servizi finanziari o di altre industrie altamente regolamentate, con una solida comprensione dei requisiti normativi e di conformità - Esperienza che supporta e gestisce piattaforme infrastrutturali aziendali critiche con un focus sulla disponibilità, resilienza, prestazioni e sicurezza - Comunicazione forte e collaborazione competenze, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team globali e tradurre concetti tecnici in soluzioni pratiche - Inglese scritto fluente e parlato (B2/C1)
• Cosa offriamo - Opportunità di contribuire alla progettazione, attuazione e implementazione della futura piattaforma Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) - Chance per ampliare la tua esperienza in diversi settori di sicurezza e sviluppare ulteriormente la tua carriera di ingegneria della sicurezza all'interno di un team collaborativo e altamente qualificato - Opportunità di lavorare con un team di ingegneria della sicurezza globale a Zurigo - Pacchetto di stipendio e benefici competitivi - Opportunità di lavorare in un ambiente di servizi finanziari altamente regolamentato Contatto Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione di lavoro completo attraverso il nostro strumento di applicazione online. Ulteriori interessanti opportunità di lavoro possono essere trovati sul nostro sito Career. Non è questo che stai cercando? Configurare un avviso di lavoro creando un account candidato qui.

• Strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills with a high level of attention to detail, particularly when working within business-critical and highly regulated environments
• Willingness and curiosity to learn new technologies and expand expertise across multiple security domains, contributing to the continuous evolution of the Bank’s security services

• Experience working within financial services or other highly regulated industries, with a solid understanding of regulatory and compliance requirements
• Experience supporting and operating business-critical infrastructure platforms with a focus on availability, resilience, performance, and security

Job-Titel Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) Beschreibung Bei Julius Baer feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie sich einbringen, unternehmerisch sind, gestärkt werden und Wert jenseits des Reichtums schaffen können. Lassen Sie uns gemeinsam die Zukunft des Vermögensmanagements gestalten. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Remote Access Engineer (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) für unser globales Security Engineering Team in Zürich. Als idealer Kandidat verfügen Sie über tiefes Know-how in sicheren Remote Access Technologien, starke Authentifizierungs- und Identitätsintegrationskompetenzen und praktische Erfahrung in der Bedienung von Enterprise-Fernkonnektivitätsplattformen in einem regulierten Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld. Sie arbeiten komfortabel in Infrastruktur, Sicherheit, Endpunkt und Identitätsdomänen, sodass Mitarbeiter, Auftragnehmer und zugelassene Dritte sicher auf Unternehmensressourcen zugreifen können. Ihre primäre Verantwortung umfasst die Planung, den Betrieb und die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Infrastruktur der Bank, der Citrix NetScaler Gateway-Infrastruktur, die Integration und Authentifizierung von Multifaktorlösungen, die Durchsetzung sicherer Zugangs- und Zugangsrichtlinien sowie die Gewährleistung der Widerstandsfähigkeit, Sicherheit und Konformität der Fernzugriffsdienste der Bank. Darüber hinaus werden Sie zur Konzeption, Umsetzung und Operationalisierung der künftigen Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) Plattform der Bank beitragen und die Entwicklung der Fernzugriffslandschaft hin zu einer modernen Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Architektur unterstützen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit IAM, Endpoint Management, Security Operations und globalen IT-Teams helfen Sie dabei, eine sichere, zuverlässige und skalierbare Fernverbindung zu schaffen, die auf regulatorische
• Anforderungen und die strategische Sicherheitsfahrplan der Bank abgestimmt ist. Neben der Remote Access Domain haben Sie auch die Möglichkeit, praktische Erfahrungen mit anderen vom Team verwalteten Sicherheitsdiensten wie Internet Proxy, Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), dem Virtual Access Management (PAM), Public Key Infrastructure (PKI) und Secure Mail Gateway Lösungen zu sammeln. Dies bietet den Kandidaten, die ihre Expertise über mehrere Security Domains erweitern und ihre Sicherheits-Engineering-Karriere innerhalb eines kollaborativen und hoch qualifizierten Teams weiter ausbauen möchten, eine hervorragende Gelegenheit. Titre de l'emploi Ingénieur d'accès à distance (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) Description Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'être impacté, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Nous recherchons un ingénieur d'accès à distance expérimenté (Citrix NetScaler & Zscaler Private Access) pour rejoindre notre équipe d'ingénierie de sécurité mondiale à Zurich. En tant que candidat idéal, vous possédez une expertise approfondie dans les technologies d'accès à distance sécurisées, des compétences d'authentification et d'intégration d'identité solides, et une expérience pratique en exploitant des plateformes de connectivité à distance de qualité entreprise dans un environnement de services financiers réglementé. Vous êtes à l'aise de travailler dans les domaines de l'infrastructure, de la sécurité, des paramètres et de l'identité, en veillant à ce que les employés, les entrepreneurs et les tiers approuvés puissent accéder en toute sécurité aux ressources de l'entreprise.
• Vos responsabilités principales consisteront à concevoir, à exploiter et à améliorer continuellement l'infrastructure de la Banque Citrix NetScaler Gateway, à intégrer et à maintenir des solutions d'authentification multi-facteurs, à appliquer des politiques d'accès sécurisé et d'accès conditionnel et à assurer la résilience, la sécurité et la conformité de la Banque, ainsi que des services d'accès à distance. En outre, vous contribuerez à la conception, à la mise en œuvre et à la mise en œuvre de la future plateforme Zscaler Private Access (ZPA) et soutiendraz l'évolution du paysage d'accès à distance vers une architecture moderne Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA). En étroite collaboration avec l'IAM, la gestion d'Endpoint, les opérations de sécurité et les équipes informatiques mondiales, vous aiderez à fournir une connectivité à distance sécurisée, fiable et évolutive, conforme aux exigences réglementaires et à la feuille de route stratégique de la Banque en matière de sécurité. Au-delà du domaine d'accès à distance, vous aurez également l'occasion de contribuer et d'acquérir une expérience pratique avec d'autres services de sécurité gérés par l'équipe, notamment Internet Proxy, l'authentification multi-facteurs (AMF), la gestion d'accès privilégié (PAM), l'infrastructure à clé publique (ICP) et les solutions Secure Mail Gateway. Cela offre une excellente occasion aux candidats qui cherchent à élargir leur expertise dans plusieurs domaines de sécurité et à développer leur carrière en ingénierie de sécurité au sein d'une équipe collaborative et hautement qualifiée. Responsabilités - Administrer, configurer et améliorer continuellement l'infrastructure de la Banque, Citrix NetScaler ADC et NetScaler Gateway, en assurant une disponibilité élevée, des performances, une évolutivité et une résilience opérationnelle dans les environnements primaires et de reprise après sinistre - Gérer et maintenir les services SSL-VPN et d'accès sans client, y compris les configurations de serveurs virtuels, les politiques d'authentification, les règles de réécriture, les politiques d'intervention et les mécanismes de pilotage du trafic - Concevoir, mettre en œuvre et maintenir des politiques d'authentification sécurisées et d'accès conditionnels basées sur l'identité de l'utilisateur, le type d'appareil, le réseau o Mettre en place et maintenir une expertise dans les technologies Citrix NetScaler Gateway et ZScaler Private Access (ZPA), appuyer la Banque, sa feuille de route stratégique pour l'accès à distance et assurer une connectivité sécurisée et transparente entre les plateformes d'accès multiples - Planifier, coordonner et mettre en oeuvre des stratégies d'accès à distance Mettre à jour l'infrastructure, les dispositifs de sécurité, les changements de politiques et les améliorations des plates-formes conformément aux processus de gestion du changement établis dans un environnement financier réglementé - Fournir un soutien technique de deuxième et troisième niveaux à la Banque, aux plates-formes d'accès à distance, agissant comme un point d'escalade pour les incidents complexes et participant à une rotation partagée 24/7 sur appel pour les services essentiels
• Exigences - Très proactives, axées sur la solution et capables d'évaluer, de hiérarchiser et de résoudre de façon structurée et efficace les problèmes techniques complexes - Fortes aptitudes analytiques et conceptuelles avec un haut degré d'attention aux détails, en particulier lorsqu'il s'agit de travailler dans des environnements critiques et hautement réglementés - minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience pratique en sécurité informatique ou en génie de l'infrastructure, avec un accent fort sur l'accès sécurisé à distance, la gestion de l'identité, les technologies d'authentification et la sécurité des paramètres - jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Julius  Baer  is  committed  to  strengthening  operational  excellence  across  its  units  through  targeted development programmes. We are currently rolling out a key learning initiative within the Chief Operating Officer (COO) unit and are seeking support for the logistical execution of this programme.

This  fixed-term  opportunity  is  ideal  for  a  working  student  or  early-career  professional  looking  to  gain valuable  experience  within  a  leading  global  wealth  manager.  Reporting  directly  to  the  Programme Manager in the COO unit, you will play a key supporting role in ensuring the smooth delivery of training sessions across the organisation and in international locations.

YOUR CHALLENGE
You will play a vital role in enabling the smooth execution of the learning programme by taking care of key logistical and administrative tasks, including:

• Coordinate training room bookings and ensure appropriate setup across locations

• Align facilitator schedules with the overall training plan in coordination with the Programme Manager

• Manage end-to-end calendar invitations for participants and facilitators, including reminders and updates

• Set up and test IT and audio-visual equipment for in-person and hybrid sessions (e.g. Webex, projectors, microphones)

• Actively support virtual and in-person sessions by managing participant flow, including assigning and recalling breakout groups

• Prepare and distribute training materials, including case studies for breakout sessions

• Track attendance, manage sign-in sheets, and follow up on missing confirmations

• Handle post-session tasks, including collecting feedback forms and returning equipment

• Maintain accurate logs, checklists, and filing for ongoing administrative efficiency

YOUR PROFILE
You bring strong organisational instincts, reliability, and a proactive attitude to support a time-sensitive initiative. What sets you apart is your genuine service orientation - the ability to anticipate needs and provide timely, thoughtful support to facilitators and participants alike.

• Current enrolment in or recent completion of a bachelor’s degree in business, Social Sciences, Education, or a related field

• Experience in administrative support, event coordination, or in a PMO-like role is valued

• While no prior banking experience is required, familiarity with operating in a structured, large corporate environment is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) and practical experience with virtual meeting platforms

• Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently under clear timelines

• A courteous, cooperative, and service-oriented approach to teamwork and stakeholder interactions

• Good command of English (written and spoken); basic German is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Julius Baer s'engage à renforcer l'excellence opérationnelle dans ses unités par des programmes de développement ciblés. • Suivre la présence, gérer les fiches d'inscription et suivre les confirmations manquantes
• Gérer les tâches après la session, y compris la collecte de formulaires de rétroaction et de matériel de retour
• Tenir des registres exacts, des listes de contrôle et des dossiers pour assurer une efficacité administrative continue. VOTRE PROFIL Vous apportez des instincts organisationnels forts, une fiabilité et une attitude proactive pour soutenir une initiative sensible au temps. Ce qui vous distingue, c'est votre véritable orientation en matière de services - la capacité d'anticiper les besoins et de fournir un soutien opportun et réfléchi aux animateurs et aux participants.
• Inscriptions actuelles ou récentes à un baccalauréat en affaires, en sciences sociales, en éducation ou dans un domaine connexe
• L'expérience en matière de soutien administratif, de coordination d'événements ou de rôle semblable à celui d'OMP est valorisée
• Bien qu'aucune expérience bancaire préalable ne soit requise, la connaissance de l'exploitation dans un environnement structuré et grand est un avantage
• Compétence en Microsoft Office (Outlook, Word, Excel) et expérience pratique avec les plateformes de réunions virtuelles
• Excellente attention aux détails et à la capacité de gérer efficacement plusieurs tâches dans des délais clairs

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Employee related Conflicts 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

For our Employee Compliance Team within Central Compliance, we are looking for a Specialist, Employee Conflicts Management to join our team. The team is responsible for the Conduct Framework, monitoring and promoting effective governance and ensuring highest standards of Compliance across our operations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Evolve the design, governance, and global implementation of the Employee Conflicts framework, ensuring alignment with evolving regulatory expectations, internal policies, and the Bank’s risk appetite

• Lead the design and operation of preventive controls for employee trading, Personal Account Transactions and conflict-of-interest frameworks, with accountability to Group Compliance and regulators

• Own and govern end-to-end processes including restricted lists, pre-clearance, and annual declarations, execution of controls driving consistency and audit readiness

• Champion process improvements through automation and technology partnerships to increase efficiency, coverage, and risk detection

• Act as escalation point for suspected breaches; lead investigations and coordinate disciplinary actions in collaboration with HR and Line Management

• Advise Senior Management on conduct risks, personal trading restrictions, and mitigation measures — delivering pragmatic, principles-based guidance aligned with business realities

YOUR PROFILE

• Either a university degree in law, business, finance, or a related field or substantial professional experience in the banking sector, particularly in areas such as trading or trade surveillance

• Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in a financial services environment, preferably within private banking or wealth management, with a solid understanding of market conduct principles and regulatory expectations

• Proven expertise in transaction monitoring and/or employee compliance, covering policy interpretation, breach assessments, investigative procedures and disciplinary recommendations

• Demonstrated interest in and contribution to the optimisation, automation and digitalisation of compliance processes – particularly in areas such as transaction monitoring, pre-clearance workflows or employee disclosure initiatives.

• Solid product and service knowledge within private banking, enabling accurate assessment of employee transactions in the context of complex instruments, investment products and advisory activities

• Proficient in Microsoft Office; experience with compliance systems, Workday, or trade surveillance platforms is an asset

• Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a distinct advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

• Entwicklung des Designs, der Governance und der globalen Umsetzung des Rahmens für Mitarbeiterkonflikte, um die Anpassung an die sich ändernden regulatorischen Erwartungen, die internen Richtlinien und die Risikobereitschaft der Bank sicherzustellen
• Führen Sie die Gestaltung und den Betrieb präventiver Kontrollen für den Mitarbeiterhandel und Rahmenbedingungen für Interessenkonflikte mit Rechenschaftspflicht gegenüber Group Compliance und Aufsichtsbehörden
• Eigene und verwaltende End-to-End-Prozesse, einschließlich eingeschränkter Listen, Vorababfertigung und Jahreserklärungen, Steigerung der Konsistenz und Auditbereitschaft
• Champion-Prozessverbesserungen durch Automatisierungs- und Technologiepartnerschaften zur Steigerung von Effizienz, Abdeckung und Risikoerkennung
• Handeln Sie als Eskalationspunkt für vermutete Verstöße; leiten Sie Ermittlungen und koordinieren Sie Disziplinarmaßnahmen in Zusammenarbeit mit HR und Line Management
• Beratung des Senior Managements in Bezug auf Verhaltensrisiken, persönliche Handelsbeschränkungen und Minderungsmaßnahmen - Bereitstellung pragmatischer, prinzipienbasierter Leitlinien, die auf die Geschäftsrealitäten ausgerichtet sind IHR PROFIL
• Entweder ein Universitätsabschluss in Rechtswissenschaften, Wirtschaft, Finanzen oder einem verwandten Bereich oder umfangreiche Berufserfahrung im Bankensektor, insbesondere in Bereichen wie Handel oder Handelsüberwachung
• Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in einem Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld, vorzugsweise im Private Banking oder Wealth Management, mit einem soliden Verständnis der Prinzipien des Marktverhaltens und der regulatorischen Erwartungen
• Nachgewiesene Expertise in der Transaktionsüberwachung und / oder Compliance von Mitarbeitern, einschließlich politischer Interpretationen, Verletzungsbewertungen, Untersuchungsverfahren und Disziplinarempfehlungen
• Nachgewiesenes Interesse an und Beitrag zur Optimierung, Automatisierung und Digitalisierung von Compliance-Prozessen – insbesondere in Bereichen wie Transaktionsüberwachung, Pre-Clearance-Workflows oder Initiativen zur Offenlegung von Mitarbeitern.
• Solides Produkt- und Servicewissen im Private Banking, das eine genaue Beurteilung von Mitarbeitertransaktionen im Kontext komplexer Instrumente, Anlageprodukte und Beratungstätigkeiten ermöglicht
• Proficient in Microsoft Office; Erfahrung mit Compliance-Systemen, Workday oder Handelsüberwachungsplattformen ist eine Bereicherung

Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Pour notre équipe de conformité des employés au sein de la conformité centrale, nous cherchons un spécialiste, Gestion des conflits d'employés pour rejoindre notre équipe. L'équipe est responsable du cadre de conduite, de la surveillance et de la promotion d'une gouvernance efficace et de la garantie de normes de conformité les plus élevées dans l'ensemble de nos opérations. VOTRE DÉFIS
• Évoluer la conception, la gouvernance et la mise en oeuvre globale du cadre des conflits d'employés, en assurant l'alignement sur l'évolution des attentes réglementaires, des politiques internes et de l'appétit pour les risques de la Banque
• Diriger la conception et le fonctionnement de contrôles préventifs pour les cadres de négociation et de conflit d'intérêts des employés, avec responsabilité envers le Groupe Conformité et les régulateurs
• Propre et régir les processus de bout en bout, y compris les listes restreintes, l'approbation préalable et les déclarations annuelles, en favorisant la cohérence et l'état de préparation à l'audit
• Améliorer les processus champions grâce à des partenariats d'automatisation et de technologie pour accroître l'efficacité, la couverture et la détection des risques
• Agir comme point d'escalade pour les infractions présumées; diriger les enquêtes et coordonner les mesures disciplinaires en collaboration avec les RH et la gestion hiérarchique
• Conseiller la haute direction sur les risques de conduite, les restrictions commerciales personnelles et les mesures d'atténuation – fournir des directives pragmatiques et fondées sur des principes, en harmonie avec les réalités commerciales VOTRE PROFIL
• Diplôme universitaire en droit, en affaires, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe ou expérience professionnelle substantielle dans le secteur bancaire, en particulier dans des domaines tels que le commerce ou la surveillance commerciale
• Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente dans un environnement de services financiers, de préférence dans le cadre de la banque privée ou de la gestion du patrimoine, avec une bonne compréhension des principes de conduite du marché et des attentes réglementaires
• Expertise éprouvée en matière de surveillance des transactions et/ou de conformité des employés, en ce qui concerne l'interprétation des politiques, les évaluations des infractions, les procédures d'enquête et les recommandations disciplinaires
• Intérêt manifesté et contribution à l'optimisation, à l'automatisation et à la numérisation des processus de conformité – en particulier dans des domaines tels que le suivi des transactions, les flux de travail avant approbation ou les initiatives de divulgation des employés.
• Connaissances solides en matière de produits et de services dans le secteur bancaire privé, permettant une évaluation précise des transactions des employés dans le contexte d'instruments complexes, de produits d'investissement et d'activités de conseil
• Compétence en Microsoft Office; expérience avec les systèmes de conformité, Workday, ou les plateformes de surveillance commerciale est un atout
• La maîtrise de l'anglais (écrite et parlée); les compétences linguistiques en allemand constituent un avantage distinct Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète à travers notre outil d'application en ligne. jobs.title: Senior Front Arena Developer 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

You will serve as a senior key person within our Front Arena team, responsible for implementing new structured products across the value chain from front office (Sales & Trading) to mid-office functions, ensuring accurate product representation and comprehensive lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Customise and extend the Front Arena platform to deliver new risk and valuation capabilities

• Design, develop, test, and deploy robust functionalities integrated across trading and back-office ecosystems

• Ensure end-to-end ownership of critical services, guaranteeing high availability and minimal production downtime

• Lead integration efforts between Front Arena and upstream/downstream systems (pricing, market data, risk engines)

• Perform root cause analysis and resolve complex production incidents efficiently

• Conduct thorough code reviews to uphold quality, security, and alignment with architectural standards

• Identify and implement system improvements to boost performance, scalability, and operational resilience

• Contribute to change and release management processes within an agile (SAFe) delivery framework

• Uphold ethical conduct, risk discipline, and compliance with all applicable regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• 10+ years of experience in Front Arena roles supporting trading, mid-office, valuation, and risk

• 8+ years of hands-on development with Front Arena AEL, ACM, and ADFL (all three required)

• Solid understanding of capital markets, particularly structured products and equity derivatives

• In-depth knowledge of financial product lifecycles (e.g., cash flows, corporate actions, expiries)

• Practical experience with Front Arena data models, workflows, and component interactions

• Experience working in agile teams using tools such as Git or Bitbucket

• Proven ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with technical and business stakeholders

• Comfortable working under pressure, with strong organisational skills and ability to prioritise dynamically

• Willingness to work on public Swiss/Zurich holidays where foreign markets are open (e.g. Aug 1st)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Data Platform Responsible 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

As a Data Platform Responsible (PR) you are responsible for the end-to-end technical leadership and lifecycle management of a global data platform (datalake house) ensuring alignment with business needs, architecture standards, and operational resilience. Working closely with Product Owners, Platform Owner, System Architects, and IT Service Owners, the Platform Responsible supports technical decision-making, oversees solution design and drives technical decision-making, responsible for successful development execution, and ensures production readiness and release planning within defined frameworks. The role combines hands-on technical oversight with supplier management, risk assessment, quality assurance, and deep involvement in agile delivery and incident support.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• You are key technical stakeholder in the technical design of a Global Platform based on a modern infrastructure

• You are part of the agile setup and support development team

• Lead the technical design, development, and operational performance of the platform, ensuring full lifecycle management and compliance with corporate standards

• Contribute to platforms technical roadmap, including technology changes, modernisation, and decommissioning, in alignment with business and architectural strategies

• Own and contribute to key deliverables including Solution Design, Security Concept, and Interface Agreements; ensure adherence to architecture standards in collaboration with the System Architect

• Plan and coordinate application releases in line with Change- and Release Management processes, jointly deciding on production go-live with the Product Owner, Platform Owner and ITSO

• Supervise platform infrastructure and data development activities, promote “shift-left” practices (automation, unit testing, CI/CD), and ensure robust implementation of functional and non-functional requirements

• Provide 3rd level support, serve as master data custodian in JBAR, and lead supplier management for third-party applications, including performance and delivery oversight

• Estimate effort for changes, advise on technical risks and mitigation, support budgeting, and ensure technical requirements are properly validated and tested prior to release

• You feel responsible for the global data platform which serves global data for different analytics use cases and ensure a running and stable environment

• Support the System Architect in the raising and maintenance of technical debts

• Support Business Responsible and IT Product Owner in shaping platform service and its execution

• Collaboration with support teams in Asia to ensure enhanced support hours

YOUR PROFILE

• At least 8 years of experience in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake houses (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage like S3/HDFS) – preferably On prem.

• Several years of work experience in a similar capacity in the financial industry

• Experience in leading technical direction of data platforms, keeping up to date with the modern possibilities of tooling, formats, concepts.

• Experience in managing the full platform lifecycle, from concept and design through development, testing, deployment, operation, and eventual retirement, including responsibility for master data, incident support, and release coordination

• VM setup and scaling (pods), K8S scaling, managing Docker with Harbor, pushing Images through CI/CD together with development team

• Higher Education in Computer Science (University, University of Applied Sciences or equivalent diploma)

• Very strong communication and planning / coordination skills

• Willingness to bring in new ideas and initiate changes and sees themselves as proactive, reliable and solution driven

• Good English language skills (written and verbal), German a plus

• Strong team player

• Customer oriented with focus to support an organisation in providing solutions

• Very good understanding of data technology and its operational management

• Very high level on self-motivation to drive initiatives and initiating changes

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Als Data Platform Responsible (PR) sind Sie für die durchgängige technische Führung und das Lifecycle-Management einer globalen Datenplattform (Datalake House) verantwortlich, die die Ausrichtung auf Geschäftsanforderungen, Architekturstandards und operative Belastbarkeit gewährleistet. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Product Ownern, Platform Owner, Systemarchitekten und IT-Service-Eigentümern unterstützt der Platform Responsible die technische Entscheidungsfindung, überwacht das Lösungsdesign und treibt die technische Entscheidungsfindung voran, ist für die erfolgreiche Ausführung der Entwicklung verantwortlich und stellt die Produktionsbereitschaft und Release-Planung innerhalb definierter Frameworks sicher. Die Rolle kombiniert praktische technische Aufsicht mit Lieferantenmanagement, Risikobeurteilung, Qualitätssicherung und einer umfassenden Beteiligung an agiler Liefer- und Incident-Unterstützung. IHRE HINWEISE
• Sie sind wichtiger technischer Stakeholder beim technischen Design einer globalen Plattform auf Basis einer modernen Infrastruktur
• Sie sind Teil des agilen Setup- und Support-Entwicklungsteams
• Führen Sie das technische Design, die Entwicklung und die operative Leistung der Plattform, um ein vollständiges Lebenszyklusmanagement und die Einhaltung der Unternehmensstandards zu gewährleisten
• Beitrag zur technischen Roadmap der Plattformen, einschließlich Technologieänderungen, Modernisierung und Stilllegung in Übereinstimmung mit Geschäfts- und Architekturstrategien
• Eigenverantwortung und Beitrag zu wichtigen Leistungen, einschließlich Solution Design, Security Concept und Interface Agreements; Gewährleistung der Einhaltung von Architekturstandards in Zusammenarbeit mit dem System Architect
• Planen und koordinieren Sie Anwendungs-Releases im Einklang mit Change- und Release-Management-Prozessen und entscheiden gemeinsam mit Product Owner, Platform Owner und ITSO über den Produktions-Go-Live
• Beaufsichtigen Sie die Plattforminfrastruktur und Datenentwicklungsaktivitäten, fördern Sie "Shift-left" -Praktiken (Automatisierung, Unit Testing, CI / CD) und gewährleisten Sie eine robuste Implementierung funktionaler und nicht funktionaler Anforderungen
• Bereitstellung von 3rd-Level-Support, als Master Data Custodian in JBAR und Leitung des Lieferantenmanagements für Anwendungen von Drittanbietern, einschließlich Leistungs- und Lieferaufsicht
• Schätzen Sie den Aufwand für Änderungen, beraten Sie zu technischen Risiken und Minderung, unterstützen Sie die Budgetierung und stellen Sie sicher, dass die technischen Anforderungen vor der Veröffentlichung ordnungsgemäß validiert und getestet werden
• Sie fühlen sich verantwortlich für die globale Datenplattform, die globale Daten für verschiedene Analyse-Anwendungsfälle bereitstellt und eine laufende und stabile Umgebung gewährleistet.
• Unterstützen Sie den Systemarchitekten bei der Erhebung und Aufrechterhaltung technischer Schulden
• Unterstützen Sie Business Responsible und IT Product Owner bei der Gestaltung des Plattformdienstes und seiner Ausführung
• Zusammenarbeit mit Supportteams in Asien, um verbesserte Supportzeiten zu gewährleisten IHR PROFIL
• Mindestens 8 Jahre Erfahrung in Data Platforms / Data Lakes / Data Lake Häusern (Kubernetes, Kafka, Distributed Storage wie S3/HDFS) – vorzugsweise On prem.
• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in ähnlicher Funktion in der Finanzbranche
• Erfahrung in der führenden technischen Leitung von Datenplattformen, auf dem neuesten Stand der modernen Möglichkeiten der Werkzeuge, Formate, Konzepte.
• Erfahrung in der Verwaltung des gesamten Plattformlebenszyklus, von Konzept und Design über Entwicklung, Test, Bereitstellung, Betrieb und eventuellen Ruhestand, einschließlich der Verantwortung für Stammdaten, Incident-Support und Release-Koordination
• VM-Einrichtung und -Skalierung (Pods), K8S-Skalierung, Verwaltung von Docker mit Harbor, Pushing von Images durch CI/CD zusammen mit dem Entwicklungsteam
• Hochschulbildung in Informatik (Universität, Fachhochschule oder gleichwertiges Diplom)
• Sehr starke Kommunikations- und Planungs-/Koordinationsfähigkeiten
• Bereitschaft, neue Ideen einzubringen und Veränderungen anzustoßen und versteht sich als proaktiv, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert
• Gute Englischkenntnisse (schriftlich und mündlich), Deutsch ein Plus
• Starker Teamplayer
• Kundenorientiert mit Fokus auf Unterstützung einer Organisation bei der Bereitstellung von Lösungen
• Sehr gutes Verständnis der Datentechnologie und ihrer Betriebsführung
• Sehr hohes Niveau an Selbstmotivation, um Initiativen voranzutreiben und Veränderungen einzuleiten Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online-Bewerbungstool. jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Serves as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert on the Swiss banks' code of conduct with regard to the exercised of due diligence (CDB 20).

YOUR CHALLENGE
