descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Nous cherchons un agent de conformité hautement organisé et proactif pour renforcer notre équipe de conformité centrale à Zurich. Dans ce rôle, vous assumerez la responsabilité de l'exécution et de l'amélioration des contrôles de surveillance de deuxième ligne (2LoD) – assurant une surveillance robuste dans les secteurs à risque critiques, y compris la qualité des clients, la tarification et le cadre intermédiaire. Ce poste offre une occasion unique de façonner l'évolution de notre cadre de contrôle de la conformité tout en servant de partenaire de confiance aux fonctions de première ligne et aux principaux intervenants. VOTRE DÉFIS
• Conception et évaluation : Élaborer, évaluer et affiner des contrôles 2LoD efficaces adaptés aux principaux risques de conformité, en assurant l'harmonisation avec les attentes réglementaires et les activités opérationnelles
• Exécution du contrôle : Exécuter en temps opportun et avec exactitude les contrôles de conformité récurrents, en mettant l'accent sur les évaluations de la qualité des clients, ainsi que sur la couverture secondaire des pratiques de tarification, du cadre intermédiaire et d'autres secteurs à risque définis
• Gestion des lacunes : S'associer étroitement avec les unités d'intervention des clients pour remédier aux faiblesses de contrôle par le biais de flux de travail structurés de remise en état (mise à profit du gestionnaire des tâches CLM), fournir des conseils et suivre la résolution de la clôture
• Rapports et validation : Effectuer une analyse et une validation approfondies des extrants de contrôle et des rapports d'exception
• Collaboration avec les intervenants : Participer à des réunions de coordination régulières avec les gestionnaires des relations d'affaires (GRO) afin de discuter des constatations, d'accroître les problèmes et de stimuler la responsabilisation
• Vérification et soutien réglementaire : agir en tant que point de contact central lors des vérifications internes et des examens de supervision externe, représentant la conception du contrôle et les résultats de rendement
• Amélioration continue : Traduire les connaissances opérationnelles en recommandations concrètes pour améliorer les processus de conformité, les outils numériques et les normes stratégiques
• Contribution Politique et formation : Contribuer à l'élaboration et à la mise à jour des politiques de conformité et jouer un rôle actif dans la conception de modules de formation ciblés pour le personnel de première ligne VOTRE PROFIL
• Apprentissage bancaire ou diplôme universitaire en banque et finances, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe
• Minimum de 3 ans d'expérience en banque privée, idéalement dans la conformité, la gestion des risques ou une fonction de contrôle
• Une bonne compréhension des règles et des processus d'adéquation des clients (p. ex. principes MiFID II, protocoles internes de CRM)
• Connaissance des activités de base de la banque privée et des risques liés à la conduite et aux opérations
• Fortes capacités d'analyse en matière d'analyse des causes profondes et de résolution des problèmes
• Utilisateur avancé de MS Office Suite, en particulier Excel (tableaux pivots, recherche) et PowerPoint (présentations exécutives)
• Un joueur d'équipe collaborative avec de l'initiative, de l'intelligence émotionnelle et de solides compétences d'engagement des intervenants
• Communication éprouvée et aptitudes interpersonnelles pour traiter avec les employés et les intervenants à différents niveaux de gestion
• Orientation détaillée avec d'excellentes capacités organisationnelles; capable de gérer plusieurs échéances dans un environnement dynamique
• Haute intégrité personnelle, discrétion et respect des normes éthiques
• Résilient et axé sur la solution, prospère sous pression tout en conservant la précision
• Connaissance de l'anglais (écrit et parlé); les autres langues sont un avantage Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète à travers notre outil d'application en ligne. D'autres possibilités d'emploi intéressantes peuvent être trouvées sur notre site de carrière. N'est-ce pas tout à fait ce que vous cherchez ? Créez une alerte emploi en créant un compte candidat ici.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

How would you use data to create the bank of the future?

As Data Management Specialist, you build the foundation for the strategic transformation at Julius Baer, driving data-centricity. You will join the team for a fixed period of time to cover a maternity leave.

You are at the heart of the bank’s transformation and bring together colleagues from all units, be it Front, IT or Compliance to achieve excellence.

Are you up for the challenge? This is your opportunity to be a driver for change and take your career to the next level.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Take-up the challenge to drive the topic during the maternity period until end of March 27

• Co-design and monitor data management standards and processes

• Co-design and monitor bank-wide data product standards and processes

• Work closely with representatives from the front office business units and supporting business functions like legal, compliance, finance, operations Enterprise Architecture and IT

• Enable and co-create with business data models according to company, industry and architectural standards

YOUR PROFILE

• Earned a university degree or equivalent, preferably in science, business informatics, banking or finance

• Several years of experience in metadata management, data dictionary, information architecture, data lineage, reference data and business glossary

• Experience in the financial industry, banking industry

• Acquainted working with data modeling and data management tools in general (data dictionary, data lineage, etc.)

• Can do attitude

• Strong at collaborating and influencing, building an effective stakeholder network across divisions and regions

• Comfortable in challenging the status quo and manage escalations on every level

• Great teammate, who is fun to work with and drives the change naturally

• Fluent in English, German would be an advantage

jobs.title: Senior SAP Project Manager – Finance Transformation 80-100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Senior SAP Project Manager is a key role within Julius Baer, located in the CFO Global Accounting, Reporting and Finance Operations department.

In this role, you will lead and deliver strategic SAP Finance projects, working closely with Finance, Business, and IT stakeholders. The position is pivotal in driving the successful implementation and evolution of SAP solutions, shaping the future Finance landscape with a strong focus on SAP S/4HANA and SAP Group Reporting.

YOUR CHALLENGE
As Senior SAP Project Manager, you will:

• Lead and deliver complex SAP Finance projects end-to-end, with focus on:

• SAP Group Reporting

• SAP S/4HANA Finance (Financial Accounting and Management Accounting)

• Enhancement and continuous evolution of the existing SAP ERP landscape

• Ensure successful project delivery in line with agreed scope, timeline, budget, and quality targets

• Be responsible for business analysis and project management and providing respective information including data flows, business requirements and test cases

• Establish and manage strong project governance, including:

• Detailed planning and milestone tracking

• Dependency and integration management

• Risk and issue management

• Preparation of decision documents with impact analysis and solution options

• Act as the main interface between Finance and IT to ensure successful implementation of SAP solutions

• Translate business requirements into SAP solutions in close collaboration with functional and technical teams

• Drive collaboration with IT and Architecture to ensure solutions are aligned with enterprise standards and CFO’s long-term strategy

• Be responsible for a qualitative and timely technical implementation, testing and sign-off

• Support business stakeholders during the transformation journey, ensuring adoption and value realization

• Identify improvement opportunities and contribute to the continuous evolution of Finance SAP systems and processes

YOUR PROFILE
The successful candidate is a seasoned SAP Project Manager with a strong track record in delivering complex SAP Finance projects in the financial services industry.

Professional Experience

• Proven experience as an SAP Project Manager delivering large-scale implementations, ideally including:

• SAP S/4HANA Finance

• Strong expertise in SAP Finance modules and related solutions (e.g., FI/CO, AA, consolidation, reporting, planning, analytics)

• Solid understanding of finance processes, including:

• Consolidation

• Controlling

• Financial Accounting

• External reporting

• Data and reporting architecture

• Experience delivering projects using both waterfall and agile methodologies

• Experience as business analyst in SAP transformation projects

• Experience in the Finance department (Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, Consolidation) of a bank within an international environment is an advantage

• Experience in financial services, ideally private banking

Skills & Competencies

• Strong delivery and execution mindset with hands-on project leadership experience

• Excellent stakeholder management skills across business and IT

• Ability to manage complex, cross-functional environments and multiple workstreams

• Pragmatic, solution-oriented, and structured working style

• Strong communication and influencing skills at all organizational levels

• Ability to manage ambiguity and drive results

Education & Languages

• University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, or a related field

• Fluent in English; German is a strong advantage

What Sets You Apart

• Hands-on experience delivering SAP Group Reporting or consolidation projects

• Deep understanding of SAP Finance architecture and data structures

• Strong track record of delivering SAP projects on time and within budget

• Strong drive to deliver tangible business value through SAP-enabled Finance transformation

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Der Senior SAP Project Manager ist eine Schlüsselrolle bei Julius Bär mit Sitz in der Abteilung CFO Global Accounting, Reporting und Finance Operations. In dieser Funktion leiten und liefern Sie strategische SAP Finance-Projekte und arbeiten eng mit Finanz-, Geschäfts- und IT-Stakeholdern zusammen. Die Position ist entscheidend, um die erfolgreiche Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von SAP-Lösungen voranzutreiben und die zukünftige Finanzlandschaft mit einem starken Fokus auf SAP S/4HANA und SAP Group Reporting zu gestalten. IHRE HINWEISE Als Senior SAP Project Manager werden Sie:
• Führen und liefern Sie komplexe SAP Finance-Projekte durchgängig mit Schwerpunkt auf:
• SAP Group Reporting
• SAP S/4HANA Finance (Finanzbuchhaltung und Management Accounting)
• Weiterentwicklung und Weiterentwicklung der bestehenden SAP ERP Landschaft
• Sicherstellung einer erfolgreichen Projektabwicklung im Einklang mit den vereinbarten Umfangs-, Zeit-, Budget- und Qualitätszielen

• Detaillierte Planung und Meilensteinverfolgung

• Förderung der Zusammenarbeit mit IT und Architektur, um sicherzustellen, dass die Lösungen an den Unternehmensstandards und der langfristigen Strategie des CFO ausgerichtet sind
• Verantwortung für eine qualitative und zeitnahe technische Umsetzung, Testing und Sign-Off
• Unterstützung der Geschäftsbeteiligten während des Transformationsprozesses, Gewährleistung der Akzeptanz und Wertrealisierung
• Verbesserungsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der SAP-Systeme und -Prozesse von Finance beitragen IHR PROFIL Der erfolgreiche Kandidat ist ein erfahrener SAP-Projektmanager mit einer starken Erfolgsbilanz bei der Durchführung komplexer SAP-Finanzprojekte in der Finanzdienstleistungsbranche. Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Le gestionnaire principal de projet SAP joue un rôle clé au sein de Julius Baer, au sein du département de la comptabilité mondiale, de l'établissement de rapports et des opérations financières du DPF. Dans ce rôle, vous dirigerez et exécuterez des projets stratégiques de SAP Finance, en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants du secteur des finances, des affaires et de la TI. La position est essentielle pour mener à bien la mise en œuvre et l'évolution des solutions SAP, façonnant ainsi le futur paysage financier en mettant fortement l'accent sur SAP S/4HANA et SAP Group Reporting. VOTRE DÉFIS En tant que gestionnaire principal de projet SAP, vous devrez :
• Diriger et exécuter les projets complexes de SAP Finance de bout en bout, en mettant l'accent sur :
• Rapports du Groupe SAP
• SAP S/4HANA Finance (Comptabilité financière et comptabilité de gestion)
• Amélioration et évolution continue du paysage SAP ERP existant
• Assurer la réussite de l'exécution du projet conformément aux objectifs convenus en matière de portée, de calendrier, de budget et de qualité
• Être responsable de l ' analyse des activités et de la gestion des projets et fournir les informations pertinentes, y compris les flux de données, les besoins opérationnels et les cas d ' essai
• Établir et gérer une saine gouvernance de projet, notamment :
• Planification détaillée et suivi des étapes
• Gestion de la dépendance et de l'intégration
• Gestion des risques et des problèmes
• Élaboration de documents de décision avec analyse d ' impact et solutions possibles
• Agir en tant qu'interface principale entre les finances et les TI pour assurer la mise en œuvre réussie des solutions SAP
• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles en solutions SAP en étroite collaboration avec les équipes fonctionnelles et techniques
• Conduire la collaboration avec l'informatique et l'architecture pour s'assurer que les solutions sont alignées sur les normes d'entreprise et la stratégie à long terme du CFO
• Être responsable d'une mise en œuvre, d'essais et d'approbations techniques qualitatives et opportunes
• Soutenir les parties prenantes pendant la transformation, en assurant l'adoption et la valorisation
• Identifier les possibilités d'amélioration et contribuer à l'évolution continue des systèmes et des processus du SAP Finances VOTRE PROFIL Le candidat retenu est un gestionnaire de projet SAP chevronné qui a une solide expérience dans la réalisation de projets SAP Finance complexes dans le secteur des services financiers. Expérience professionnelle
• Expérience éprouvée en tant que gestionnaire de projet SAP fournissant des implémentations à grande échelle, notamment :
• SAP S/4HANA Finance
• Une solide expertise dans les modules SAP Finance et les solutions connexes (p. ex. FI/CO, AA, consolidation, rapport, planification, analyse)
• Une bonne compréhension des processus financiers, notamment :
• Consolidation
• Contrôle
• Comptabilité financière
• Rapports externes
• Architecture des données et des rapports
• Expérience dans la réalisation de projets utilisant à la fois des méthodes de cascade et des méthodes agiles
• Expérience en tant qu'analyste d'affaires dans les projets de transformation SAP
• L'expérience du département des Finances (Comptabilité financière, Comptabilité de gestion, Consolidation) d'une banque dans un environnement international est un avantage
• Expérience dans les services financiers, idéalement la banque privée Compétences
• Forte mentalité de prestation et d'exécution avec une expérience pratique de leadership de projet
• Excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes dans les entreprises et les TI
• Capacité de gérer des environnements complexes et interfonctionnels et de multiples flux de travail
• Style de travail pragmatique, orienté vers la solution et structuré
• Communication forte et influence des compétences à tous les niveaux organisationnels
• Capacité à gérer l'ambiguïté et à produire des résultats Éducation et langues
• Diplôme universitaire en informatique, en génie, en finance ou dans un domaine connexe
• Fluent en anglais; l'allemand est un fort avantage Ce qui vous sépare
• Expérience pratique de la réalisation de projets SAP Group Reporting ou consolidation
• Connaissance approfondie de l'architecture SAP Finance et des structures de données
• Forte expérience de l'exécution des projets SAP dans les délais et dans les limites du budget

jobs.title: Senior Business Analyst – SAP Finance 80-100% (m/f/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner until 31.03.2028 with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Represent the Finance function in a Core Banking transformation programme: Ensuring accurate integration of Finance data flows, interfaces and related changes needed on the Finance applications (including Financial Acc, Management Acc, Reg reporting, Treasury)

• Impact Assessment Financial Accounting changes: Gathering of business requirements for Finance applications resulting from the New Core Banking implementation

• Translate business needs into Functional design documents through collaborative requirement analysis. Specification for data sourcing, mapping rules, and other changes within Finance applications (i.e. SAP S/4HANA) based on the upstream functionality changes

• Support seamless interoperability between core banking platforms and Finance application

• Impact Assessment with regards to data migrations from Core Banking and Markets applications to SAP and other Finance applications

• Work closely with project managers, functional leads, BAs, and developers during all phases of project lifecycle

• Change Management: Support organizational change by communicating and syndication changes to stakeholders

YOUR PROFILE

• Prove track record as a Senior Business Analyst within a banking environment

• Strong experience with financial accounting principles and banking operations, particularly regarding the integration of financial accounting systems with upstream applications such as trading platforms, core banking systems, or risk management tools

• Familiarity with other Finance business areas, including Financial Accounting, Management Accounting, and Regulatory Reporting

• In-depth knowledge of SAP Finance and hands-on experience in Finance implementations; Temenos knowledge is a plus

• Understanding of key SAP Finance components: Financial Accounting & Regulatory Reporting, Cost Centre Accounting (CCA), Profit Centre Accounting (PCA), as well as data and integrations

• Knowledge of banking-specific finance processes such as General Ledger, Chart of Accounts (COA), reconciliations, and management/regulatory reporting

• Experience with data migration activities

• Advanced skills in SAP Finance, combined with solid experience in system integration patterns and data sourcing & migration

• Hands-on and delivery-focused

• Fluency in English required; German skills are beneficial

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.title: Third-Party Risk Manager – CRO Non-Financial Risk 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a risk professional to support our Third-Party Risk Management unit. The Third Party Risk Management unit as second line of defence function maintains and develops the Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) framework, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the Risk Management Framework. This position reports to the Head of TPRM, who  is the Global Policy Owner (GPO) of third party risk-related policies as well as the Risk Type Owner (RTO) of the risk type “Third Party Management Risk (incl. intragroup services)”.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Support the end-to-end implementation and global rollout of the Group’s third-party risk management framework in line with the defined roadmap

• Define business use cases and functional requirements for IT implementations and AI-enabled solutions; design and execute test procedures for infrastructure upgrades and system migrations

• Assist the RTO in portfolio risk assessments, operational case reviews, control monitoring, and international regulatory reporting; drive timely follow-up on action items, incidents, and escalation flags

• Compile, validate, and prepare quantitative and qualitative reporting packages for committees and key stakeholders

• Maintain and update central documentation (Wiki pages, procedures, templates, intranet), develop training materials, and deliver training sessions to ensure consistent adoption across locations

• Coordinate stakeholder meetings, track progress on framework implementation, and conduct quality checks on resolution strategies and exit plans globally

YOUR PROFILE

• University degree or equivalent (preferably in economics / law)

• Broad and practical experience in non-financial risk management, with a minimum of 3-5 years within management consulting or accounting / law firm

• Sound knowledge of outsourcing/third party risk regulations and industry best practices

• Familiarity with ServiceNow for process automation, ticketing, and IT service management workflows.

• Able to formulate clear business requirements for IT implementations and AI use cases within  the TPRM related applications, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements .

• Strong “hands on” analytical and project delivery capabilities, with the ability to turn concepts into practical, implementable solutions

• Excellent PowerPoint and presentation skills

• Proven ability to rapidly learn new concepts and ideas, and integrate and assimilate information of various levels of complexity and relationships across broad, multifunctional content areas

• Self-motivated, team-oriented and hands-on personality

• Strong communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

• Able to work under pressure and react positively in the face of change

• Fluency in German and English, any further language is an advantage

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Nous cherchons un professionnel des risques pour soutenir notre unité de gestion des risques de tiers. L'unité de gestion des risques des tiers, en tant que deuxième ligne de la fonction de défense, maintient et élabore le cadre de gestion des risques des tiers, en veillant au respect des exigences réglementaires et à l'harmonisation avec le cadre de gestion des risques. Ce poste relève du responsable de TPRM, qui est le propriétaire de la politique mondiale (GPO) des politiques de tiers liées au risque ainsi que du propriétaire du type de risque (RTO) du type de risque --Risque de gestion de tiers (y compris les services intragroupes). VOTRE DÉFIS
• Soutenir la mise en œuvre de bout en bout et le déploiement global du cadre de gestion des risques des tiers du Groupe conformément à la feuille de route définie
• Définir des cas d'utilisation commerciale et des exigences fonctionnelles pour les implémentations informatiques et les solutions adaptées à l'IA; concevoir et exécuter des procédures d'essai pour les mises à niveau de l'infrastructure et les migrations de systèmes
• Aider l'OTR à évaluer les risques du portefeuille, à examiner les cas opérationnels, à surveiller le contrôle et à établir des rapports réglementaires internationaux; assurer un suivi en temps opportun des mesures à prendre, des incidents et des drapeaux d'escalade
• Compiler, valider et préparer des ensembles de rapports quantitatifs et qualitatifs pour les comités et les principaux intervenants
• Tenir à jour et mettre à jour la documentation centrale (pages Web, procédures, modèles, intranet), élaborer du matériel de formation et offrir des séances de formation pour assurer une adoption uniforme dans tous les lieux d ' affectation
• Coordonner les réunions des parties prenantes, suivre les progrès accomplis dans la mise en œuvre du cadre et effectuer des vérifications de la qualité des stratégies de résolution et des plans de sortie à l ' échelle mondiale VOTRE PROFIL
• Diplôme universitaire ou équivalent (de préférence en économie / droit)
• Expérience étendue et pratique en gestion des risques non financiers, avec un minimum de 3 à 5 ans au sein du cabinet de conseil en gestion ou en comptabilité / droit
• Bonne connaissance de la réglementation en matière d ' externalisation/de risques de tiers et des meilleures pratiques de l ' industrie
• Familiarité avec ServiceNow pour l'automatisation des processus, la billetterie et les workflows de gestion des services informatiques.
• Capacité de formuler des exigences opérationnelles claires pour les mises en œuvre de TI et les cas d'utilisation d'IA dans les applications liées au GRPT, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs opérationnels et les exigences réglementaires .
• Fortes capacités d'analyse et de réalisation de projets, avec la capacité de transformer les concepts en solutions pratiques et réalisables
• Excellente compétence PowerPoint et présentation
• Capacité éprouvée d'apprendre rapidement de nouveaux concepts et idées, et d'intégrer et d'assimiler des informations de divers niveaux de complexité et de relations dans des domaines de contenu vastes et multifonctionnels
• Personnalité automotivée, orientée vers l'équipe et pratique
• Bonne communication, présentation et aptitudes interpersonnelles
• Capable de travailler sous pression et de réagir positivement face au changement
• Connaissance de l'allemand et de l'anglais, toute autre langue est un avantage Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète à travers notre outil d'application en ligne. jobs.title: Junior Quantitative Analyst, GPS, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a highly motivated Quantitative Analyst to design, develop, and integrate advanced pricing and risk analytics solutions for our global derivatives trading business.

In this role, you will bridge cutting-edge quantitative knowledge with robust software engineering, delivering scalable tools used across trading.

The quant team is part of the Trading Team, within our Global Products & Solutions Unit in Zürich.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Design, develop, and maintain advanced quantitative tools and services that support the bank’s derivative trading activities

• Implement and enhance derivative pricing models and ensure their seamless integration into risk management systems

• Drive cross-functional projects involving multiple teams and stakeholders, ensuring alignment and delivery of quantitative solutions

• Collaborate closely with Risk and IT departments to validate models, streamline workflows, and support production integration

YOUR PROFILE

• Ph.D. or Master’s degree in a quantitative discipline (e.g., Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Quantitative Finance)

• Solid understanding of financial mathematics, probability theory, and stochastic calculus, with practical experience applying these concepts

• Strong programming skills in at least one compiled language. Familiarity with Scala and the Java ecosystem is a plus

• 2 to 4 years of relevant professional experience in a quantitative development or model implementation role, ideally within a bank or hedge fund (including internships, GTP or regular junior role)

• Excellent communication skills in English; proficiency in German is an advantage.

• Strong team player with a proactive, hands-on mindset and the ability to deliver high‑quality work under tight deadlines

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible for overseeing the end-to-end operation of an IT service in accordance with predefined service level agreements. This encompasses the thorough understanding and meticulous tracking of all service dependencies and proactive lifecycle management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
In the beginning the following two topics will be in focus:

• The Central Identity Data Platform for JB. It provides user and persona entries along with master data. Clients connect through JID's RESTful and streaming interfaces to read the respective access data.

• BJB central UID web Service. The UIDservice is the source for user id’s in JB. It will calculate user id’s for different types of users such as employees, non-personal users, BOI users and others

Additionally, the following activities apply:

• Application management (Maintenance and Support, SLA, Incident-, Problem-, Release/Test-, Risk-Mgmt, Lifecycle, Documentation) within the area of "Identity and Access Management"

• Business Analysis, Solution Design and implementation/deployment of Changes/Enhancements in cooperation with the software vendor

• Implementation and Testing of Product Releases

• Project assignments (Data migrations, impact analysis)

• No staff management, no budget responsibility

YOUR PROFILE

• The ideal candidate has solid IT knowledge and skills (especially in Linux, Java, PowerShell and ORACLE) and more than one year of experience in Identity and Access Management. Banking experience is a plus

• Creation and maintenance of application documentation

• Experience in testing of new requirements

• In-depth knowledge of access management principles, including identity lifecycle management, role-based access control, and attribute-based access control

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills paired with ability to interpret complex technical information

• Fast learner and understanding of business context and project governance

• Able to communicate with business and technical stakeholders

• Sound skills in Jira and Confluence

• Project management certification or corresponding qualification / experience

• Communication, problem solving, social interaction & cross-cultural mindset, empathy & relationship management, coaching, can-do spirit

• Negotiation skills with different stakeholder groups

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Java Engineer – HPC Cluster Development & Maintenance, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking a strong Java engineer to develop and maintain a High-Performance Computing (HPC) cluster comprising hundreds of servers (on-premises and augmented by Microsoft Azure). This cluster provides critical computing power to a modern trading floor.

The cluster scheduling and control systems are primarily built in Java, with Apache Ignite as the clustering layer. Jobs are received from internal clients via legacy HTTP and ActiveMQ interfaces, while modern clients use an in-house API developed in Java and Python. System statistics are collected in MongoDB and Elastic/Kibana.

This role requires ensuring high availability for a mission-critical resource, developing a deep understanding of a large existing codebase, and proposing improvements. You will also maintain and enhance multiple monitoring systems for both infrastructure and client job submissions.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Develop and maintain Java-based cluster scheduling and control systems.

• Ensure high availability and reliability of HPC resources.

• Maintain and improve monitoring systems for infrastructure and client submissions.

• Collaborate with internal stakeholders to balance resource allocation with business requirements.

• Troubleshoot and optimize performance across on-prem and Azure-augmented environments.

• Ensure compliance with banking regulatory requirements.

YOUR PROFILE

• Strong Java multithreaded development expertise (core and enterprise-level)

Experience with:

• Distributed Execution Engines.

• NoSQL Databases

• ActiveMQ (messaging)

• Front-end Web Technologies (legacy UI maintenance)

• Python (for API and tooling)

Familiarity with:

• Azure Portal and Azure SDK for Java

• Red Hat Linux

• Understanding of banking systems and regulatory requirements

• Language: Fluent English; German is a plus

Bonus Skills:

• Scala and C++

• Kubernetes (container orchestration)

What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on mission-critical systems in a high-performance environment

• Exposure to cutting-edge HPC and cloud technologies

• Collaborative team culture in a dynamic trading environment

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

• Anforderungen des Bankensektors. jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager - Liquidity Risk Management Asia 100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We are seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to manage the implementation and adjust “Liquidity Risk Management Asia” to enhance internal liquidity controls and tools to fulfil regulations.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensure comprehensive requirement gathering, analysis, and documentation in close partnership with business stakeholders in Risk, Treasury, Compliance, and regional entities

• Take full ownership of end-to-end project delivery, ensuring adherence to agreed scope, timeline, budget, quality standards, and regulatory objectives

• Guarantee strict compliance with Julius Baer’s project governance framework, including milestone approvals, stage-gate reviews, and minimum security and control standards

• Manage all administrative aspects of the project lifecycle, including progress reporting, financial tracking, forecast updates, resource planning, and risk & issue logging

• Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders across IT, Finance, Treasury, Risk & Compliance, delivering clear and timely communication tailored to audience needs

• Prepare and deliver high-quality presentations to steering committees, executive sponsors, and operational teams

• Champion smooth transition and sustainable handover of delivered solutions to Operations organisations, supported by adequate documentation and change enablement activities

• Apply agile principles and tools effectively, particularly leveraging Jira and Confluence for backlog, task, and knowledge management

YOUR PROFILE

• Proven track record in managing large-scale IT projects with CtB-budgets >CHF 1m

• Familiarity with liquidity risk management frameworks, regulatory reporting, or treasury operations in a financial institution

• Demonstrated experience leading global, matrixed projects involving internal and external teams, as well as third-party vendors

• Hands-on approach to project execution, with proven ability to independently manage all operational aspects of large-scale IT projects, including regular reporting, budget tracking, financial controlling, resource allocation, and milestone forecasting

• Solid command of modern project management toolsets, especially Jira and Confluence

• Certified Project Manager (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, or equivalent)

• Excellent interpersonal and negotiation skills with ability to influence diverse stakeholder groups across cultures and time zones

• Fast learner with strong analytical thinking, capable of quickly grasping complex business contexts, regulatory drivers, and technical landscapes.

• Problem-solving aptitude, emotional intelligence, empathy, and relationship management skills essential for collaborative success

• Coaching mindset and team-oriented approach, combined with a proactive, results-driven attitude ("can-do spirit")

• Outstanding communication and presentation abilities - fluent in English; German language skills are a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet informatique expérimenté pour gérer la mise en œuvre et ajuster la gestion des risques de Liquidity Asia. VOTRE DÉFIS
• Assurer la collecte complète des besoins, l'analyse et la documentation en étroite collaboration avec les intervenants du secteur des risques, de la trésorerie, de la conformité et des entités régionales
• Prendre pleinement en charge l'exécution des projets de bout en bout, en veillant au respect de la portée, du calendrier, du budget, des normes de qualité et des objectifs réglementaires convenus
• Garantir le strict respect du cadre de gouvernance du projet de Julius Baer, y compris les approbations d'étapes, les examens par étapes et les normes minimales de sécurité et de contrôle
• Gérer tous les aspects administratifs du cycle de vie du projet, y compris les rapports d'étape, le suivi financier, les mises à jour des prévisions, la planification des ressources et l'enregistrement des risques et des émissions
• Servir de point de contact principal pour les intervenants dans les domaines de la TI, des finances, de la trésorerie, des risques et de la conformité, en assurant une communication claire et opportune adaptée aux besoins de l'auditoire
• Préparer et présenter des présentations de haute qualité aux comités directeurs, aux commanditaires exécutifs et aux équipes opérationnelles
• Champion d'une transition sans heurt et d'une transmission durable des solutions fournies aux organisations opérationnelles, soutenues par des activités de documentation et de changement adéquates
• Appliquer efficacement les principes et les outils agiles, notamment en tirant parti de Jira et Confluence pour la gestion de l'arriéré, des tâches et des connaissances VOTRE PROFIL
• Expérience éprouvée dans la gestion de grands projets informatiques avec des budgets CtB >CHF 1m
• Connaissance des cadres de gestion du risque de liquidité, des rapports réglementaires ou des opérations de trésorerie dans une institution financière
• Expérience démontrée à la tête de projets mondiaux et matriciaux impliquant des équipes internes et externes, ainsi que des fournisseurs tiers
• Approche pratique de l'exécution des projets, avec une capacité éprouvée de gérer de façon indépendante tous les aspects opérationnels des projets informatiques à grande échelle, y compris l'établissement de rapports réguliers, le suivi budgétaire, le contrôle financier, l'allocation des ressources et la prévision des jalons
• Une solide maîtrise des outils modernes de gestion de projet, notamment Jira et Confluence
• Gestionnaire de projet certifié (p. ex. PMP, PRINCE2, PMI-ACP, ou équivalent)
• Excellentes aptitudes interpersonnelles et de négociation avec la capacité d'influencer divers groupes d'intervenants à travers les cultures et les fuseaux horaires
• Apprentis rapide avec une pensée analytique forte, capable de saisir rapidement des contextes d'affaires complexes, des moteurs réglementaires et des paysages techniques.
• Capacité de résolution de problèmes, intelligence émotionnelle, empathie et compétences de gestion des relations essentielles au succès collaboratif
• Encadrer la mentalité et l'approche axée sur l'équipe, combinée à une attitude proactive axée sur les résultats ("can-do spirit")

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Do you aspire to be part of a high performing Analytics and Transformation team within a global Compliance organisation at the forefront of the wealth management industry? In this diverse role you will implement new technologies, manage change initiatives, develop predictive models, and perform financial and economic analysis to increase the efficiency and effectiveness of risk management. Working alongside Risk, Compliance, Analytics and Legal SMEs in highly skilled, fast-paced teams you will drive business value through collaboratively solving complex analytical problems.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Lead and support data analytics and business intelligence initiatives to success, with focus on Non-Financial Risk (e.g., Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Client Review or Sanctions)

• Collaborate with internal IT and external providers to conduct in-depth analyses and identify best-in-class solutions by leveraging latest technology as well as the Compliance Analytics & Transformation in-house built infrastructure

• Design, develop, monitor and document predictive models following industry best practices and sound theoretical foundation

• Work closely with senior stakeholders to design quantitative solutions using different analytical principles to optimise various banking processes

• Assess and manage change requests raised by the business

• Execute regular and ad-hoc analysis and reports

YOUR PROFILE

• Master or Bachelor’s degree from a university of applied sciences in STEM fields (science, technology, engineering, mathematics)

• 2-3 years of Banking experience with focus on Compliance, Risk Management and Legal

• Strong communication skills with the ability to decompose complex solutions and data insights into a compelling storyline for the rest of the organisation

• As an agile worker, you enjoy working in a fast-paced environment where things evolve quickly

• Enthusiastic about leveraging data and statistics to solve complex problems

• Curious to learn new things and apply out-of-the-box thinking to challenge the status quo and proactively propose new solutions

• Team-oriented and enjoy collaborating with diverse experts, listening to different ideas and voicing your own, to deliver the best possible outcome

• Strong database programming skills (e.g. SQL)

• Proficient in programming (e.g. in Python, R, Java, or C++)

• Experience in project management or business analysis

• Fluent in English (main business language), any further language is an advantage

jobs.title: Team Head Data Center of Excellence 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Data Center Of Excellence in Global Operations Services has a twofold mission. It delivers critical daily processes such as tax reporting or reconciliation, as well as has a continuous focus to improve these via process engineering, automation or control solutions towards process excellence. The Team Head is responsible for planning and achieving these targets, while supporting and coaching the team of 14+ members.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Leadership and Coaching: Establishing and implementing the vision, team oversight and capacity management, team development through training plans and coaching

• Ensuring the daily business activity: the team performs Data Quality controls and Data Cleansing activities. Ensuring completeness, resource management and oversight of the activity

• Transformation: Define a roadmap for implementing transformation such as automations, process reengineering or monitoring solutions. Establish the framework on when to use various capabilities available to the team. Develop access to further tools and integration possibilities. Ensure that solutions are reusable and appropriately documented

• Skills development: Encourage the team to develop their skills to further improve BAU quality or support Transformations actively

YOUR PROFILE

• Leadership and coaching skills, previous leadership experience required

• Several years of experience in managing and/or delivering Banking Operations processes

• Experience in client tax reporting or corporate actions is a plus

• Curiosity to get deep understanding of the business processes to identify improvements

• Project management experience

• Process engineering, process automation, data analytics

• Strong Analytical skills to understand and resolve complex problems

• University education (or equivalent academic degrees) in Business, Finance, Data Engineering or similar

• Fluent in English and good German skills would be a plus

• Data and Tech literacy for Data analytics, Data Modeling experience would be a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Data Analytics Platform 80-100% (f/m/d) - (Contract through our external payroll partner with immediate start for 12 months with possible extension)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

In our team, you will be a key contributor to building our Data Platform as a foundation for Data Analytics and AI.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and backend services for real-time decisioning, reporting, data collecting, and related functions

• Data Requirements and Modeling

• Data Management and Transformation

• Produce high-quality, well-tested, and secure code

• Develop and maintain software designed to improve data governance and security

• Develop processes designed to ensure Data Security and Data Quality

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related technical field; or equivalent training and professional experience

• 5+ years of experience in ETL/ELT, data warehousing, Business Intelligence, and integrating data processing/workflow management tools into pipeline design

• 5+ years building and maintaining end-to-end data systems using Python, Scala, or similar programming languages

• Solid experience in utilising SQL for data analysis, investigating data issues, diagnosing root causes, and designing effective solutions

• Experience in working with cloud-based data technologies, preferably on Microsoft Azure, within continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) environments

• Demonstrated experience working with large-scale datasets using Databricks, PySpark, Spark Streaming, and Delta Lake

• Hands-on experience with structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data across various storage systems, including relational databases (RDBMS), data warehouses, in-memory caches, and document databases

• Familiarity with cloud storage solutions such as Azure Data Lake and Blob Storage

• Solid understanding of data modelling principles (experience with Data Vault is a plus) and strong skills in system design, implementation, and testing

• Experience with event-driven architectures (e.g., Kafka, Event Hubs, Apache Flink) and containerised microservices platforms (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker, Helm Charts)

• Knowledge and practical use of dbt (data build tool), experience with BI tools

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, ability to provide technical leadership to other developers

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

Chez Julius Baer, nous célébrons et valorisons les qualités individuelles que vous apportez, vous permettant d'avoir un impact, d'être entrepreneur, d'être autonomisé et de créer une valeur au-delà de la richesse. Laissez-les façonner ensemble l'avenir de la gestion des richesses. Dans notre équipe, vous serez un contributeur clé pour construire notre plateforme de données en tant que base pour l'analyse de données et l'IA. VOTRE DÉFIS
• Concevoir, développer et maintenir des pipelines de données et des services de soutien pour la prise de décisions en temps réel, la production de rapports, la collecte de données et les fonctions connexes
• Exigences en matière de données et modélisation
• Gestion et transformation des données
• Produire un code de qualité, éprouvé et sécurisé
• Développer et entretenir des logiciels conçus pour améliorer la gouvernance et la sécurité des données
• Élaborer des processus conçus pour assurer la sécurité et la qualité des données VOTRE PROFIL
• Baccalauréat ou maîtrise en informatique, analyse de données, systèmes d'information ou un domaine technique connexe; ou formation équivalente et expérience professionnelle
• 5+ des années d'expérience dans ETL/ELT, l'entreposage des données, le renseignement d'affaires et l'intégration des outils de traitement des données et de gestion des flux de travail dans la conception des pipelines
• 5+ années de construction et de maintenance de systèmes de données de bout en bout utilisant des langages de programmation Python, Scala ou similaires
• Expérience solide dans l'utilisation de SQL pour l'analyse de données, l'étude des problèmes de données, le diagnostic des causes profondes et la conception de solutions efficaces
• Expérience dans le travail avec les technologies de données basées sur le cloud, de préférence sur Microsoft Azure, dans les environnements d'intégration et de livraison continue (CI/CD)
• Expérience démontrée avec des ensembles de données à grande échelle utilisant Databricks, PySpark, Spark Streaming et Delta Lake
• Expérience pratique des données structurées, semi-structurées et non structurées dans divers systèmes de stockage, y compris les bases de données relationnelles (RDBMS), les entrepôts de données, les caches en mémoire et les bases de données documentaires
• Familiarité avec les solutions de stockage en nuage telles que Azure Data Lake et Blob Storage
• Compréhension solide des principes de modélisation des données (l'expérience avec Data Vault est un plus) et des compétences solides dans la conception, la mise en œuvre et l'essai des systèmes
• Expérience des architectures événementielles (par exemple Kafka, Event Hubs, Apache Flink) et des plateformes de microservices containerizzato (par exemple Kubernetes, Docker, Helm Charts)
• Connaissance et utilisation pratique de dbt (outil de création de données), expérience des outils BI
• Excellentes compétences en communication et collaboration, capacité à fournir un leadership technique à d'autres développeurs Nous sommes impatients de recevoir votre candidature complète à travers notre outil d'application en ligne. jobs.title: Payments Investigations Specialist 80 - 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Responsible of conducting the business of the particular function in a way that the operations run smoothly, with good quality, in line with the agreed standards & goals and with risk management awareness. They contribute to the definition of new products/standards and implement them in the respective function and initiate the optimization of services/processes.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Payments Investigations with internal parties, such as Front Colleagues, Compliance and external parties, such as international branches and our Correspondent banks via telephone, email and SWIFT

• Documenting and solving cases in the internal case management application in line with the regulatory requirements

• Analysing and processing open cash positions (reconciliation)

• Preparing and processing internal reversals

• First level filtering: Real-time sanction hit handling of false positive matches with escalation of full and close matches to second level Compliance

YOUR PROFILE

• Profound knowledge of SWIFT, SEPA and SIC payments processing and ISO20022 messages

• Seeking new challenges, continuous changes and ongoing improvements

• Strong team-player with can-do attitude

• Solution oriented and intrinsically motivated to deliver a tailor-made service for our clients

• High attention to detail combined with proven problem-solving skills

• Flexible, reliable and resilient personality

• Sound risk awareness

• Open to continuously learn and develop new skills

• Fluent in English and German

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

jobs.title: Front Arena Product Owner, Zürich, 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

We’re seeking a highly experienced and driven Product Owner to lead the evolution of our mission-critical Front Arena platforms across global equities and equity derivatives trading. In this pivotal role within Global Markets, you’ll sit at the intersection of technology, trading, and risk, shaping the strategic direction and delivery of best-in-class trading, analytics, and risk management solutions.

With deep roots in financial markets and a proven ability to bridge complex stakeholder needs, you'll drive the end-to-end product lifecycle, from defining the roadmap to overseeing agile delivery and ensuring rigorous quality assurance. You’ll collaborate closely with traders, quants, risk managers, and tech teams across Zurich, Singapore and Mumbai, translating front-office demands into powerful, scalable solutions that power our market-making and trading activities.

We're looking for a strong team player who combines a decade-long expertise in Front Arena, hands-on experience in equity derivatives trading environments, and exceptional stakeholder management skills, someone who speaks both ‘trader’ and ‘developer’ and can navigate high-pressure conversations with confidence and precision.

This is more than a product role; it’s a chance to shape how one of the leading wealth managers trades and manages risk in fast-moving global markets. If you thrive in dynamic, collaborative settings and want to leave a tangible impact on our trading infrastructure, we want to hear from you.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Roadmap Definition: Defining and executing the strategic roadmap for Front Arena analytics, trading, and risk management tools

• Stakeholder Management: Engaging with traders, platform managers, quants, risk managers, operations managers and various other stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional specs

• Product Development: Overseeing the end-to-end implementation of new features for several equity derivatives trading desks

• Project management and business analyst: Support in the redesign/implementation of market making, trade position management, life cycle management, risk management and trade booking systems

• Quality Assurance: Serving as the last line of defence in user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure tools are fit for purpose, performant, and compliant with regulatory requirements

YOUR PROFILE

• 10-15 years of Front Arena experience overall and in depth understanding of key technologies used

• Ideally 5+ years Front Arena development experience or equivalent development experience

• Experience working in agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Scrum) and DevOps practices

• Extensive experience of working with trading floor stakeholders, 3-5 years of front, risk, or mid office experience ideally

• Extensive experience and knowledge of equity and equity derivatives products in European and Asian structured products

• Proven track record in delivering Front-office trading or analytics tools

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi Siamo Julius Baer, celebriamo e valorizziamo le qualità individuali che offrite, consentendovi di essere efficaci, imprenditoriali, di essere capaci di creare valore al di là della ricchezza. Lasciate che il futuro della gestione patrimoniale sia definito insieme. Descrizione
• Stiamo cercando un Product Owner altamente esperto e guidato per guidare l'evoluzione delle nostre piattaforme mission-critical Front Arena attraverso il trading globale di strumenti azionari e derivati azionari. In questo ruolo fondamentale all'interno dei mercati globali, si. siederà all'incrocio di tecnologia, trading e rischio, formando la direzione strategica e la consegna di best-in-class trading, analisi e soluzioni di gestione del rischio. Con radici profonde nei mercati finanziari e una comprovata capacità di colmare le complesse esigenze degli stakeholder, si guiderà il ciclo di vita del prodotto end-to-end, dalla definizione della tabella di marcia per supervisionare la consegna agalese e garantire rigorosa garanzia di qualità. Collaborate a stretto contatto con commercianti, trucchetti, responsabili del rischio e team tecnologici di Zurigo, Singapore e Mumbai, traducendo le richieste in front-office in soluzioni potenti e mobili che alimentano le nostre attività di mercato e di trading.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together. We’re seeking a highly experienced and driven Product Owner to lead the evolution of our mission-critical Front Arena platforms across global equities and equity derivatives trading. In this pivotal role within Global Markets, you’ll sit at the intersection of technology, trading, and risk, shaping the strategic direction and delivery of best-in-class trading, analytics, and risk management solutions. With deep roots in financial markets and a proven ability to bridge complex stakeholder needs, you'll drive the end-to-end product lifecycle, from defining the roadmap to overseeing agile delivery and ensuring rigorous quality assurance. You’ll collaborate closely with traders, quants, risk managers, and tech teams across Zurich, Singapore and Mumbai, translating front-office demands into powerful, scalable solutions that power our market-making and trading activities. We're looking for a strong team player who combines a decade-long expertise in Front Arena, hands-on experience in equity derivatives trading environments, and exceptional stakeholder management skills, someone who speaks both ‘trader’ and ‘developer’ and can navigate high-pressure conversations with confidence and precision. This is more than a product role; it’s a chance to shape how one of the leading wealth managers trades and manages risk in fast-moving global markets. If you thrive in dynamic, collaborative settings and want to leave a tangible impact on our trading infrastructure, we want to hear from you. YOUR CHALLENGE
• Roadmap Definition: Defining and executing the strategic roadmap for Front Arena analytics, trading, and risk management tools
• Stakeholder Management: Engaging with traders, platform managers, quants, risk managers, operations managers and various other stakeholders to translate business requirements into functional specs
• Product Development: Overseeing the end-to-end implementation of new features for several equity derivatives trading desks
• Project management and business analyst: Support in the redesign/implementation of market making, trade position management, life cycle management, risk management and trade booking systems
• Quality Assurance: Serving as the last line of defence in user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure tools are fit for purpose, performant, and compliant with regulatory requirements YOUR PROFILE
• 10-15 years of Front Arena experience overall and in depth understanding of key technologies used
• Ideally 5+ years Front Arena development experience or equivalent development experience
• Experience working in agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, Scrum) and DevOps practices
• Extensive experience of working with trading floor stakeholders, 3-5 years of front, risk, or mid office experience ideally
• Extensive experience and knowledge of equity and equity derivatives products in European and Asian structured products
• Proven track record in delivering Front-office trading or analytics tools We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. jobs.title: T24 Application Support / Operation Engineer 100% (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

System engineering is an interdisciplinary field of system and platform engineering, complemented with business management and operational responsibility, that centres around on how to design and manage complex systems and technology platforms over their life cycles. The system engineer can assume a pure holistic role or can be a database, system/server, virtualization or a network specialist.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Ensuring the operation of core banking applications in respect to application management (2nd level support)

• Processing of incident tickets generated by monitoring systems and the local service desk within SLAs

• Performing coordination / communication tasks between incident managers, applications service owners, 3rd-level support and other IT / Business stakeholders

• Takeover of periodical on-call duty (weekly 7x24)

• Administration of change requests, for application related process fulfillment

• Participation in periodic releases on weekends

• Engage in projects relating to operational aspects for existing or newly integrated applications

• Routine data cleansing of the systems

• Process optimization and automation of repetitive tasks including handover to L1 (Control Center)

• Keep application operation documentation (knowledge database) up to date

YOUR PROFILE

• Completed IT Education (Degree in Computer Science or other IT related field)

• Experience with Temenos T24: Proven ability to manage, monitor, and troubleshoot daily operations, including end-of-day (COB) processing. Proficient in operational tools such as JBoss, Oracle database, TAFJ, DSF, Octopus, Splunk, and Dynatrace. Familiarity with the TPH module is an advantage

• At least 5 years of professional experience in T24 support

• Good Linux know-how (shell scripting is an advantage)

• Knowledge of Java application server and AWA scheduler is an advantage

• Knowledge of ITIL Foundation

• Proven experience in banking with a strong knowledge of financial products

• Process-oriented and analytical approach

• Enthusiastic team player with strong communication skills

• Highly motivated, and proactive, with an eagerness to learn and take on new concepts

• Good written and spoken English, German is a plus

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.
Is this not quite what you are looking for? Set up a job alert by creating a candidate account here.

jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking supports one or more Relationship Manager(s) (RM)/ Team Head(s) (TH) in daily operations, administration, client care and relationship management. The ARM interacts with internal as well as external stakeholders, provides clients with relevant information and supports the RM in implementing customized solutions. Furthermore, the ARM acts as role model in bringing the best service quality to the RMs/TH in a fast, professional and friendly manner, always living the Julius Baer values (Care, Passion and Excellence) and thus helping the team to manage and grow its current client base. He/she channels client feedback to the relevant individuals/departments within the Bank to foster continuous improvement and fast adaptation of processes. This position is the backbone of Client Relationship Management.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Client Administration & Management

• Supports RMs/TH in client interaction and all related tasks (systems, processes, files, documents etc.) with high-quality, precision and timely responsiveness

• Customizes client requests (reporting, statistics, mailings etc.)

• Manages the RM/TH’s calendar, prepares client meetings, organizes business trips, completes the post processing of client calls, client meetings or business trips for RMs/TH

• Compiles presentations, supports in drafting investment  proposals and in marketing activities if needed (client reception, meetings, business trips, events etc.)

• Ensures coverage in case of own absences

Business Management

• Regularly collects and exchanges relevant information necessary for the job

• Organises himself/herself in an efficient and compliant manner and ensures timely and appropriate information of the superior

• Conducts reviews, plans ahead and documents his/her work at all times

• Supports RM/TH in implementation of projects and initiatives

• Provides professional input proposals for improvements based on experience, incident occurrence or observation

• Manages the expense claim process for RMs/TH

Risk Management & Controls

• Actively helps managing risk (support first line of defence), i.e. in client documentation, by raising concerns, following up on issues and by escalating when in doubt

• Ensures adherence to local regulations and compliance with internal policies and standards (e.g. new account openings, payment instructions, reviewing client phone calls or signing off at own level of competence etc.) in collaboration with the respective RMs and TH

• Ensures timely clearance of pending items and escalated deficiencies

• Ensures appropriate ethical and compliant behaviour in his/her area of responsibility

• Ensures correct, meaningful and understandable documentation of client interaction/client orders in the corresponding tool (e.g. CRM, DiAS)

YOUR PROFILE
Personal & Social Skills

• Team player

• Excellent situational adaptability (able to work with RMs and clients from diverse backgrounds)

• Friendly, trustworthy and discreet personality with high level of risk awareness

• Highly service oriented and passionate about client servicing

• Always communicates in a friendly, competent and professional manner

• Open, approachable an displays genuine interest in people and in improving processes

• Systematic, precise and diligent working style and the ability to perform under pressure

• Personal integrity and ethical behaviour

Professional Skills

• Sound affinity with the geographic market(s) covered, i.e. familiar with the legal and regulatory environment as well as cultural awareness

• Good understanding of relevant products and services in Private Banking

• Basic knowledge of global financial markets and current developments in the industry

Education and Experience

• Relevant educational (bank apprenticeship or equivalent) and professional background (work experience in the financial industry)

• Good language skills (verbal and written) according to specific market requirements

• Proven track record in servicing banking clients with complex needs (onboarding of new, maintaining and extending current relationships)

We are looking forward to receiving your full job application through our online application tool. Further interesting job opportunities can be found on our Career site.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei Julius Bär feiern und schätzen wir die individuellen Qualitäten, die Sie mitbringen, damit Sie wirkungsvoll sein, unternehmerisch handeln, gestärkt werden und Werte jenseits von Wohlstand schaffen können. Gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft des Wealth Managements. Der Assistant Relationship Manager (ARM) Private Banking unterstützt einen oder mehrere Relationship Manager (RM) / Teamleiter (TH) im täglichen Betrieb, in der Verwaltung, in der Kundenbetreuung und im Beziehungsmanagement. Der ARM interagiert mit internen und externen Stakeholdern, stellt den Kunden relevante Informationen zur Verfügung und unterstützt die RM bei der Implementierung maßgeschneiderter Lösungen. Darüber hinaus fungiert der ARM als Vorbild, um die beste Servicequalität schnell, professionell und freundlich in die RMs / TH zu bringen, immer die Werte von Julius Bär (Care, Passion und Excellence) zu leben und so dem Team zu helfen, seinen derzeitigen Kundenstamm zu verwalten und auszubauen. Er leitet Kundenfeedback an die relevanten Personen/Abteilungen innerhalb der Bank, um eine kontinuierliche Verbesserung und schnelle Anpassung der Prozesse zu fördern. Diese Position ist das Rückgrat des Client Relationship Management. IHRE HINWEISE Client Administration & Management
• Unterstützt RMs/TH bei der Kundeninteraktion und allen damit verbundenen Aufgaben (Systeme, Prozesse, Dateien, Dokumente etc.) mit hoher Qualität, Präzision und zeitnaher Reaktionsfähigkeit
• Passt Kundenanfragen an (Berichte, Statistiken, Mailings usw.)
• Verwaltet den Kalender der RM/TH, bereitet Kundenbesprechungen vor, organisiert Geschäftsreisen, schließt die Nachbearbeitung von Kundenanrufen, Kundenbesprechungen oder Geschäftsreisen für RMs ab. D
• Erstellt Präsentationen, unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Investitionsvorschlägen und bei Marketingaktivitäten bei Bedarf (Kundenempfang, Meetings, Geschäftsreisen, Veranstaltungen usw.)
• Gewährleistung der Deckung bei eigenen Abwesenheiten Unternehmensführung
• Sammelt und tauscht regelmäßig relevante Informationen aus, die für den Job notwendig sind
• Organisiert sich effizient und konform und sorgt für rechtzeitige und angemessene Informationen des Vorgesetzten
• Führt jederzeit Überprüfungen durch, plant voraus und dokumentiert seine Arbeit
• Unterstützt RM/TH bei der Umsetzung von Projekten und Initiativen
• Bietet professionelle Input-Vorschläge für Verbesserungen basierend auf Erfahrung, Vorfall oder Beobachtung
• Verwaltet den Kostenerstattungsprozess für RMs / TH Risikomanagement & Kontrollen
• Aktiv hilft beim Risikomanagement (Unterstützung der ersten Verteidigungslinie), z. B. in der Kundendokumentation, indem Bedenken geäußert, Probleme verfolgt und im Zweifelsfall eskaliert werden
• Sicherstellt die Einhaltung lokaler Vorschriften und die Einhaltung interner Richtlinien und Standards (z. B. neue Kontoeröffnungen, Zahlungsanweisungen, Überprüfung von Kundenanrufen oder Abmeldung auf eigener Kompetenzebene usw.) in Zusammenarbeit mit den jeweiligen RMs und TH
• Gewährleistung der fristgerechten Abfertigung ausstehender Artikel und eskalierter Mängel
• Gewährleistung eines angemessenen ethischen und konformen Verhaltens in seinem Verantwortungsbereich
• Sicherstellt eine korrekte, aussagekräftige und verständliche Dokumentation der Kundeninteraktion/Kundenaufträge im entsprechenden Tool (z.B. CRM, DiAS) IHR PROFIL Persönliche und soziale Fähigkeiten
• Teamplayer
• Hervorragende situative Anpassungsfähigkeit (in der Lage, mit RMs und Clients mit unterschiedlichem Hintergrund zu arbeiten)
• Freundliche, vertrauenswürdige und diskrete Persönlichkeit mit hohem Risikobewusstsein
• Sehr serviceorientiert und leidenschaftlich über Kundenservice
• Kommuniziert immer freundlich, kompetent und professionell
• Offen, zugänglich und zeigt echtes Interesse an Menschen und an der Verbesserung von Prozessen
• Systematischer, präziser und fleißiger Arbeitsstil und Leistungsfähigkeit unter Druck
• Persönliche Integrität und ethisches Verhalten Berufliche Fähigkeiten
• Solide Affinität zu dem/den abgedeckten geografischen Markt(en), d. h. Vertrautheit mit dem rechtlichen und regulatorischen Umfeld sowie kulturelles Bewusstsein
• Gutes Verständnis relevanter Produkte und Dienstleistungen im Private Banking
• Grundkenntnisse der globalen Finanzmärkte und aktuelle Entwicklungen in der Branche Bildung und Erfahrung
• Relevante Ausbildung (Banklehre oder gleichwertig) und beruflicher Hintergrund (Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbranche)
• Gute Sprachkenntnisse (verbal und schriftlich) entsprechend den spezifischen Marktanforderungen
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Betreuung von Bankkunden mit komplexen Bedürfnissen (Einbindung neuer, Aufrechterhaltung und Erweiterung bestehender Beziehungen) Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständige Bewerbung über unser Online-Bewerbungstool.
